features.showcase_hint: Would delay rendering until external resources load; rendering is unaffected.

features.name: playbackorder / timelinebegin
features.showcase_hint: Would prevent seeking backwards or start the timeline on load event; no visible effect.

features.name: version attribute
features.support_note: Removed in SVG 2; ignored by all browsers
features.showcase_hint: version="1.1" versus none renders identically.

features.name: svg x/y position (nested only)
features.support_note: all browsers; ignored on the outermost svg
features.showcase_hint: Two identical nested svgs at different x/y offsets appear side by side; the same attribute on the root has no effect.

features.name: xml:base removed
features.support_note: Removed from SVG 2; Chrome and Safari never resolved it, Firefox dropped it
features.showcase_hint: Relative href under an element with xml:base resolves against the document URL, not the xml:base value.

features.name: xmlns:xlink declaration
features.support_note: Only needed for xlink:href in XML; unnecessary with SVG 2 href
features.showcase_hint: A standalone file using xlink:href fails to parse without the xlink namespace; href works without it.

features.name: zoomAndPan magnify/disable
features.support_note: Deprecated in SVG 2; effectively ignored on standalone SVG in current Chrome, Firefox and Safari
features.showcase_hint: A standalone SVG with zoomAndPan=disable can still be zoomed by the user; no visible difference.

features.name: requiredExtensions conditional attribute
features.support_note: Evaluates false for unknown URIs everywhere; Firefox treats MathML/XHTML namespaces as true
features.showcase_hint: A child with requiredExtensions set to an unknown URI never shows, so the fallback sibling renders.

features.name: requiredFeatures conditional attribute
features.support_note: Removed in SVG 2; modern browsers ignore it (treated as passing)
features.showcase_hint: A child with any requiredFeatures string renders as if the attribute were absent.

features.name: symbol preserveAspectRatio
features.showcase_hint: Two uses of one symbol into a wide box: one letterboxed (meet), the other stretched (none).

features.name: symbol x/y/width/height geometry
features.support_note: Inconsistent; Chrome honours width/height on symbol, Firefox and Safari incomplete
features.showcase_hint: A symbol carrying its own width/height renders at that size when use gives no size.

features.name: xlink:href legacy reference
features.support_note: Still rendered by all browsers; deprecated in SVG 2, href wins when both present
features.showcase_hint: The same star rendered via xlink:href; with both attributes set the href target is the one that shows.

features.name: view preserveAspectRatio
features.showcase_hint: The same view region shown letterboxed vs sliced depending on the view's preserveAspectRatio.

features.name: view viewBox
features.showcase_hint: Two view elements with different viewBoxes act as zoom presets for one drawing.

features.name: view viewTarget
features.support_note: Removed in SVG 2; no browser highlights the target
features.showcase_hint: Would highlight a named element when the view is activated; visibly nothing happens.

features.name: xml:space=preserve whitespace handling
features.support_note: Deprecated in SVG 2 but still honoured by all browsers
features.showcase_hint: Text with multiple spaces keeps them as wide gaps instead of collapsing to one.

features.name: preserveAspectRatio xMaxYMax meet
features.showcase_hint: Content fits entirely in the bottom-right corner of the viewport.

features.name: preserveAspectRatio xMaxYMax slice
features.showcase_hint: Content covers the viewport; the bottom-right region is visible.

features.name: preserveAspectRatio xMaxYMid meet
features.showcase_hint: Content fits entirely, flush right and vertically centred.

features.name: preserveAspectRatio xMaxYMid slice
features.showcase_hint: Content covers the viewport; the right-middle region is visible.

features.name: preserveAspectRatio xMaxYMin meet
features.showcase_hint: Content fits entirely and sits in the top-right corner of the viewport.

features.name: preserveAspectRatio xMaxYMin slice
features.showcase_hint: Content covers the viewport; the top-right region is visible.

features.name: preserveAspectRatio xMidYMax meet
features.showcase_hint: Content fits entirely, centred horizontally, flush to the bottom edge.

features.name: preserveAspectRatio xMidYMax slice
features.showcase_hint: Content covers the viewport; the bottom-centre band is visible.

features.name: preserveAspectRatio xMidYMid meet (default)
features.showcase_hint: Content letterboxed and centred both ways; this is what you get with no attribute.

features.name: preserveAspectRatio xMidYMin meet
features.showcase_hint: Content fits entirely, centred horizontally, flush to the top edge in a wide viewport.

features.name: preserveAspectRatio xMidYMin slice
features.showcase_hint: Content covers the viewport; the top-centre band is visible, sides clipped.

features.name: preserveAspectRatio xMinYMax meet
features.showcase_hint: Content fits entirely in the bottom-left corner of a tall viewport.

features.name: preserveAspectRatio xMinYMax slice
features.showcase_hint: Content covers the viewport; the bottom-left region is visible.

features.name: preserveAspectRatio xMinYMid meet
features.showcase_hint: Content fits entirely, flush left and vertically centred in a wide viewport.

features.name: preserveAspectRatio xMinYMid slice
features.showcase_hint: Content covers the viewport; the left-middle region is visible.

features.name: preserveAspectRatio xMinYMin meet
features.showcase_hint: Content scaled to fit entirely, hugging the top-left corner with empty space on right/bottom.

features.name: preserveAspectRatio xMinYMin slice
features.showcase_hint: Content scaled to cover the viewport; the top-left region is visible and the rest is clipped away.

features.name: Conditional attributes hide elements outside switch
features.showcase_hint: A plain rect with systemLanguage="xx" simply disappears without any switch wrapper.

features.name: defs and forward references anywhere in document
features.showcase_hint: A use placed before its defs (which appears at the end of the file) still renders the referenced shape.

features.name: Duplicate ids resolve to the first element
features.showcase_hint: Two shapes sharing id="x"; every use href="#x" renders the first one, the second is never instanced.

features.name: Presentation property inheritance through g
features.showcase_hint: fill and stroke set once on a g colour all children; one child overrides locally and shows a different colour.

features.name: min/max-width and height constraining root svg sizing
features.support_note: applies to root svg boxes in all browsers; ignored on inner rects/images
features.showcase_hint: A responsive root svg stops growing at max-width: 600px while an inner rect ignores max-width.

features.name: Whitespace and comma tolerance in attribute lists
features.support_note: all browsers accept surrounding whitespace and comma/space mixes; trailing comma tolerance varies
features.showcase_hint: viewBox=" 0,0, 100 100 " and points=" 0,0 10,0 10,10 " still render identically to their tidy forms.

features.name: Percentages resolve against nearest viewport
features.showcase_hint: A rect with width=50% inside a nested svg is half the inner viewport, not half the outer drawing.

features.name: script allowed as child of any element
features.support_note: all browsers execute script nested inside g or defs
features.showcase_hint: A script nested inside a g runs on load and recolours a sibling shape.

features.name: Scripts not executed in img/background/use
features.showcase_hint: The same SVG animates via script as an object/inline but stays static when loaded through img.

features.name: Media queries inside SVG respond to its own viewport
features.showcase_hint: One SVG file shown via img at two sizes displays different layouts because @media matches its own width.

features.name: svgView(preserveAspectRatio(...)) fragment
features.showcase_hint: The URL fragment alone switches a crop from meet to slice.

features.name: svgView(transform(...)) fragment
features.showcase_hint: file.svg#svgView(transform(rotate(45))) shows the whole drawing rotated via the URL.

features.name: svgView(viewTarget(...)) fragment
features.showcase_hint: Would highlight an element by id from the URL; nothing renders differently today.

features.name: svgView(zoomAndPan(...)) fragment
features.support_note: Deprecated with zoomAndPan; ignored by Chrome and Safari
features.showcase_hint: Would lock user zoom on a standalone view; visibly no difference in most browsers.

features.name: switch does not affect script/style processing
features.showcase_hint: A style inside a non-chosen switch branch still colours shapes elsewhere in the document.

features.name: symbol never renders without use
features.showcase_hint: A symbol outside defs shows nothing in place; only its use instances appear.

features.name: title/desc must be first children
features.support_note: Browsers still tooltip a later title, but accessibility mapping prefers first child
features.showcase_hint: A title placed as first child yields a tooltip and accessible name; compare with one placed after shapes.

features.name: use across separate inline svgs in one HTML page
features.showcase_hint: A hidden inline svg holds symbols; many other inline svgs on the page render them via #id.

features.name: Cyclic use references render nothing
features.support_note: all browsers treat the cycle as an error and skip it
features.showcase_hint: A g containing a use that references itself renders nothing, while a sibling non-cyclic use renders normally.

features.name: use referencing an external document without fragment
features.support_note: Chrome 137+ only; Firefox and Safari require a #fragment
features.showcase_hint: use href="icon.svg" with no #id shows the whole external file's root element.

features.name: use instances as Shadow DOM with event retargeting
features.showcase_hint: Clicking a use instance reports event.target as the use element, not the cloned child.

features.name: use of symbol defaults to 100% size
features.showcase_hint: A use without width/height pointing at a symbol fills the entire enclosing viewport.

features.name: viewBox origin offset (pan/crop)
features.showcase_hint: Shifting viewBox min-x/min-y crops into a different region of the same content, like a camera pan.

features.name: overflow: auto/scroll on svg viewports
features.support_note: inline root svg in HTML respects overflow; no browser shows scrollbars on inner svg
features.showcase_hint: overflow:scroll on an inner svg behaves like hidden (no scrollbars), while the root svg in HTML can scroll.

features.name: HTML page stylesheet styles inline SVG
features.showcase_hint: A rule in the host page's stylesheet changes the fill of inline SVG shapes but not of the same SVG in an img.

features.name: unknown element placeholder
features.support_note: No browser implements SVGUnknownElement; unrecognised tags become plain SVGElement and render nothing
features.showcase_hint: An unrecognised tag in the SVG namespace renders nothing and its children are ignored; DOM shows generic SVGElement.

features.name: aria-hidden / role=presentation on decorative groups
features.showcase_hint: Decorative gridlines group is hidden from the accessibility tree while still painted; role=presentation on shapes likewise.

features.name: image href (SVG 2 unprefixed)
features.support_note: all browsers; xlink:href still accepted as fallback
features.showcase_hint: Two images side by side, one using href and one using xlink:href, both render identically.

features.name: image preserveAspectRatio (meet alignment)
features.showcase_hint: Same photo in a wide box with xMinYMid, xMidYMid and xMaxYMid meet: letterboxed image shifts left, center, right.

features.name: aria-label on SVG elements
features.showcase_hint: Accessibility inspector or an on-page script displays the aria-label as the accessible name, overriding title text.

features.name: role=img on svg root
features.showcase_hint: Accessibility tree shows the chart as a single image named by title/aria-label instead of reading each shape.

features.name: CSS grid/flex layout inside foreignObject
features.showcase_hint: A responsive card grid or flex row with gaps and centered items rendered inside the SVG canvas.

features.name: filter/clip-path/mask on foreignObject
features.support_note: Chrome and Firefox fine; Safari drops filters or clips on foreignObject in some cases
features.showcase_hint: HTML paragraph blurred by feGaussianBlur and clipped to a circle, or masked with a gradient fade.

features.name: Interactive HTML form controls inside SVG
features.support_note: all browsers; hit-testing bugs under transforms in older Safari
features.showcase_hint: Working input, checkbox, select and button embedded in the drawing; typing/clicking updates a nearby SVG text via script.

features.name: Flowing, wrapping HTML text via foreignObject
features.support_note: all browsers, including SVG loaded in img
features.showcase_hint: A paragraph auto-wraps to multiple lines within the foreignObject width, unlike SVG text which runs off in one line.

features.name: MathML formula inside foreignObject
features.showcase_hint: A rendered fraction with radical and superscripts drawn as a label on a plotted curve.

features.name: Transforms applied to foreignObject
features.support_note: renders everywhere; Safari mis-positions fixed/absolute descendants and hit-testing under transforms
features.showcase_hint: An HTML card rotated 15 degrees and skewed, its text remaining selectable and crisp.

features.name: HTML video/canvas/iframe inside foreignObject
features.support_note: Safari has long-standing bugs with video/iframe inside transformed foreignObject
features.showcase_hint: A playing video clipped to a vector shape via clip-path, or an iframe embedded within a rotated SVG frame.

features.name: data: URI raster embedding
features.showcase_hint: Self-contained SVG with a base64 PNG in href renders the picture with no network request, even when saved offline.

features.name: SVG file referenced by image (secure static mode)
features.support_note: all browsers; scripts, external resources and interactivity disabled inside the referenced SVG
features.showcase_hint: An external .svg with viewBox scales into the image box like vector art; its hover effects and links do nothing, external fonts fall back.

features.name: Inline SVG in an HTML document
features.showcase_hint: SVG text inherits the page font-family and color; page CSS styles svg shapes; no xmlns needed; DOM accessible to page scripts.

features.name: Intrinsic size rules for embedded SVG
features.showcase_hint: Same SVG as img: with width/height renders at that size; with only viewBox it fills the given width keeping ratio; with nothing defaults to 300x150.

features.name: Presentation attribute vs CSS cascade (specificity 0)
features.showcase_hint: fill="red" attribute loses to a .cls{fill:blue} rule and even to a bare circle{fill:blue} rule; wins over inherited values only.

features.name: Standalone SVG XML document
features.showcase_hint: File opened directly in a tab: XML declaration, xmlns on root, root svg is :root; document fills the viewport per width/height/viewBox.

features.name: Inline style attribute on SVG elements
features.showcase_hint: style="fill:green" overrides both the fill attribute and a stylesheet rule on the same element.

features.name: SVG as CSS background-image / mask-image
features.showcase_hint: A tiled vector pattern as background of an HTML element scaling crisply at any zoom; media queries inside the SVG react to the box size.

features.name: SVG in HTML img / picture (secure static mode)
features.showcase_hint: Same SVG inline vs in img: the img copy has no hover effects, no script output, external fonts/images replaced by fallbacks, alt text exposed.

features.name: SVG via object/embed/iframe (scripts enabled)
features.showcase_hint: SVG in object keeps its scripted animation and hover states; object fallback content shows when the file 404s.

features.name: tabindex on SVG elements and :focus styling
features.showcase_hint: Pressing Tab moves a visible focus ring across shapes with tabindex=0; :focus-visible CSS changes their stroke.

features.name: Property inheritance from use into its shadow tree
features.showcase_hint: One symbol instantiated by three use elements with different fill/color values renders in three colours (unset fills inherit).

features.name: CSS custom properties and var() in presentation properties
features.showcase_hint: Changing --accent on the root recolours every fill/stroke using var(--accent); a slider-driven inline style updates the whole icon set.

features.name: @media (forced-colors) and system colors
features.support_note: Chrome/Edge and Firefox; Safari does not implement forced-colors
features.showcase_hint: In Windows High Contrast the chart re-paints with CanvasText/Highlight system colours and forced-color-adjust keeps brand fills.

features.name: @media print inside SVG
features.showcase_hint: Print preview shows a black-and-white version with hidden interactive controls while the screen version stays coloured.

features.name: @media (width) responsive SVG in img/object
features.support_note: all browsers; evaluates against the SVG's own viewport, not the host page
features.showcase_hint: Same logo file in three img widths shows full wordmark, abbreviated, and icon-only variants.

features.name: @media (prefers-color-scheme: dark)
features.support_note: all browsers, including SVG in img and favicons
features.showcase_hint: Logo switches to light strokes on dark background when the OS theme is dark, even when embedded via img.

features.name: @media (prefers-reduced-motion)
features.showcase_hint: A spinning gear stops (animation:none) when the OS reduce-motion setting is on; a static caption explains the state.

features.name: foreignObject element
features.support_note: all browsers; x/y/width/height also settable via CSS in SVG 2
features.showcase_hint: A styled HTML block (bordered div with a heading) positioned by x/y inside the SVG among circles and paths.

features.name: image element
features.showcase_hint: A raster photo (PNG/JPEG/WebP/AVIF) drawn inside the SVG coordinate system next to vector shapes, sharing transforms and opacity.

features.name: image-rendering property
features.support_note: all browsers for auto/pixelated; keyword set differs per engine
features.showcase_hint: A tiny 8x8 sprite scaled 20x shown twice: auto is blurry/smoothed, pixelated shows hard square pixels.

features.name: currentColor for icons inheriting HTML color
features.showcase_hint: Inline icon set next to text picks up the paragraph's color; changing the parent color property recolours all icons.

features.name: Accessing embedded SVG DOM via contentDocument
features.showcase_hint: Page button recolours a shape inside the object-embedded SVG through contentDocument.getElementById.

features.name: SVGElement.style CSSStyleDeclaration
features.showcase_hint: Script sets el.style.fill and el.style.setProperty('--accent', ...) and the shape recolours immediately.

features.name: SVGImageElement.decode()
features.showcase_hint: Image appears only after decode() resolves, so a large picture pops in fully decoded; status text shows 'decoded'.

features.name: a rel / referrerpolicy / hreflang / type
features.support_note: rel=noopener/noreferrer honoured in Chrome/Firefox; referrerpolicy and hreflang exposure uncertain in Safari
features.showcase_hint: Link with rel="noopener" target="_blank" opens a tab whose window.opener is null (displayed by the opened page).

features.name: xlink:arcrole / xlink:role
features.showcase_hint: No visible effect; link renders and navigates identically with or without the attribute.

features.name: xlink:show
features.support_note: ignored by all browsers; target attribute replaces it
features.showcase_hint: No visible effect; link opens per target attribute regardless of xlink:show=new.

features.name: xlink:type / xlink:actuate
features.showcase_hint: No visible effect; xlink:actuate=onLoad does not auto-navigate.

features.name: foreignObject width/height
features.support_note: all browsers; SVG 2 auto keyword resolves to 0 in practice
features.showcase_hint: HTML paragraph wraps within the foreignObject width and is clipped beyond its height.

features.name: foreignObject x/y
features.showcase_hint: HTML block positioned at an offset inside the SVG, aligned with a vector marker at the same coordinates.

features.name: image crossorigin attribute
features.support_note: all browsers; Safari support arrived late (15+)
features.showcase_hint: Cross-origin image with crossorigin=anonymous can be drawn to canvas and read back (pixels shown); without it getImageData throws.

features.name: image decoding hint (sync/async)
features.support_note: Chrome 116+, Safari 17.4+; Firefox ignores on SVG image
features.showcase_hint: Large image with decoding=async lets surrounding vector animation keep running smoothly while decoding; sync shows a frame hitch.

features.name: image fetchpriority hint
features.support_note: Chromium only; Firefox and Safari ignore on SVG image
features.showcase_hint: No visible difference; network panel shows the high-priority image requested before other resources.

features.name: image width/height (explicit or auto from intrinsic size)
features.support_note: all browsers; very old Safari rendered nothing without width/height
features.showcase_hint: Image with no width/height renders at the raster's natural pixel size; setting only width scales height proportionally.

features.name: image x/y position
features.showcase_hint: The same photo placed at three different x/y offsets inside the drawing, aligned with vector guides.

features.name: aria-describedby referencing desc
features.showcase_hint: Accessibility tree exposes long description text from desc; visible via inspector or script-based overlay.

features.name: aria-labelledby referencing title/text ids
features.showcase_hint: Accessible name assembled from several referenced text elements (title + value label) shown in the accessibility tree.

features.name: focusable attribute (SVG Tiny 1.2 / IE)
features.support_note: only legacy IE/Edge honoured it; ignored by all modern browsers
features.showcase_hint: Element with focusable="true" but no tabindex is skipped when tabbing, proving the attribute has no effect.

features.name: a target values (_blank/_self/_top/_parent)
features.showcase_hint: Clicking one shape opens a new tab, another navigates the current frame, another replaces the top window.

features.name: a target _replace
features.support_note: removed in SVG 2; browsers treat as a named window
features.showcase_hint: Link with target="_replace" opens a new window/tab named _replace rather than replacing the SVG in place.

features.name: role=group with aria-label on subdiagrams
features.showcase_hint: Diagram sections show as labelled groups in the accessibility tree; visible focus outline moves between groups when tabbing.

features.name: role=list/listitem structure on groups
features.showcase_hint: Bar chart groups exposed as a list of items with names like 'Q1, 40%', navigable item by item in the accessibility tree.

features.name: preserveAspectRatio none (non-uniform stretch)
features.showcase_hint: A circular logo squashed into an ellipse because the image is stretched to fill a non-square viewport.

features.name: preserveAspectRatio slice (cover/crop)
features.showcase_hint: Photo fills the whole box with edges cropped, versus meet leaving empty bands; overflow clipped by the image viewport.

features.name: WAI-ARIA Graphics roles (graphics-document/object/symbol)
features.support_note: exposed by Chrome/Firefox; Safari/VoiceOver support inconsistent
features.showcase_hint: Accessibility inspector shows graphics-document on root and graphics-symbol on legend icons instead of generic roles.

features.name: animated GIF/APNG/WebP inside image
features.showcase_hint: An animated GIF loops inside an SVG image element while vector shapes around it stay static.

features.name: Unknown namespaced elements/attributes ignored (inkscape:, sodipodi:)
features.showcase_hint: Drawing with editor-specific attributes and sodipodi:namedview renders exactly like a cleaned copy; unknown elements draw nothing.

features.name: Rasterising SVG+foreignObject via canvas drawImage
features.support_note: Chrome/Firefox OK with inlined resources; Safari taints canvas; Firefox needs explicit root width/height
features.showcase_hint: An inline SVG containing HTML is serialized, drawn to a canvas and shown as a PNG thumbnail beside the original.

features.name: foreignObject overflow (UA default hidden)
features.showcase_hint: Tall HTML content is cut off at the foreignObject height by default; a copy with overflow:visible spills beyond the box.

features.name: HTML scaled by viewBox in foreignObject
features.showcase_hint: Same HTML content in two SVGs with different viewBox ratios renders at different apparent font sizes, scaling with the drawing.

features.name: XHTML namespace requirement in standalone SVG
features.showcase_hint: Standalone file: div with xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1999/xhtml" renders as HTML; a div without the namespace renders nothing.

features.name: XHTML link rel=stylesheet inside SVG
features.support_note: Chrome and Firefox honour html:link inside svg; Safari support inconsistent
features.showcase_hint: Standalone SVG using <link xmlns=xhtml rel=stylesheet href=theme.css> renders coloured shapes from the external file.

features.name: HTML parser foreign-content rules (case fix-up, no namespace)
features.showcase_hint: In HTML, lowercase <lineargradient> and <clippath> are case-fixed and render; self-closing <path/> honoured; CDATA needed in XML only.

features.name: Inline svg is display:inline (baseline gap)
features.showcase_hint: An inline svg in a div shows a few pixels of space below it; display:block or vertical-align:top removes the gap.

features.name: Duplicate ids across several inline SVGs
features.showcase_hint: Two inlined icons both defining #grad: the second picks up the first's gradient colours; renaming ids fixes it.

features.name: style inside inline SVG applies to the whole HTML document
features.showcase_hint: A style element inside inline SVG with p{color:red} turns HTML paragraphs red; scoping via #id selectors prevents it.

features.name: Language-dependent font and glyph selection
features.showcase_hint: Han unification characters, Turkish dotless i (text-transform), or locale-specific quotes render differently per lang value.

features.name: spatial media fragments (#xywh=) on image resources
features.support_note: no browser applies #xywh= to raster or SVG resources
features.showcase_hint: image href="a.png#xywh=0,0,50,50" would show a crop; browsers show the full image.

features.name: RDF / Dublin Core inside metadata
features.support_note: all browsers ignore for rendering; consumed by Inkscape/search tools
features.showcase_hint: dc:title, dc:creator, cc:license in rdf:RDF; a script displays them as a credits caption proving namespaced content survives.

features.name: Encoding SVG in data: URIs (utf8, # escaping)
features.support_note: all browsers; unescaped # and quotes break the URI
features.showcase_hint: Two CSS backgrounds: url-encoded (%23 for #) SVG shows the gradient; the raw-# version shows nothing.

features.name: SVG favicon with embedded dark-mode CSS
features.support_note: Chrome and Firefox; Safari ignores SVG favicons (uses mask-icon)
features.showcase_hint: Tab icon is a vector SVG that swaps colours with prefers-color-scheme; Safari shows no icon.

features.name: SVG text exposed to find-in-page, selection and AT
features.support_note: all browsers; selection behaviour differs slightly
features.showcase_hint: Ctrl+F highlights words inside SVG text; dragging selects vector text; text converted to paths cannot be found.

features.name: SVG user-agent stylesheet defaults
features.showcase_hint: Nested svg clips its overflow by default; overflow:visible lets a shape spill; defs/symbol/clipPath render nothing until referenced.

features.name: Document selectors do not reach into use shadow trees; custom properties do
features.showcase_hint: .icon path{fill:red} on the use fails to recolour the cloned path, while --icon-color consumed via var() inside the symbol works.

features.name: var() inside presentation attributes
features.support_note: Chrome and Firefox; Safari inconsistent; fails in non-CSS renderers
features.showcase_hint: fill="var(--c, orange)" attribute renders orange when the variable is unset and the variable colour when defined.

features.name: xlink:href and xmlns:xlink namespace
features.support_note: still rendered by all browsers; deprecated in SVG 2; xmlns:xlink declaration required in XML
features.showcase_hint: Standalone file using xlink:href on image/use/a renders; the same file without the xmlns:xlink declaration fails to parse.

features.name: XML entities, internal DTD entity definitions and CDATA sections
features.support_note: all browsers for internal DTD entities; external DTD subsets not fetched
features.showcase_hint: Standalone SVG defines &brand; in an internal DTD and reuses it in fill attributes; style sheet wrapped in CDATA with a raw '>' selector.

features.name: Strict XML parsing (well-formedness failures)
features.showcase_hint: Standalone SVG with an unescaped & or unclosed tag shows the browser's XML parse error page; inline HTML SVG tolerates it.

features.name: Container queries around/inside SVG
features.support_note: SVG elements cannot be query containers; works for HTML wrappers and foreignObject content
features.showcase_hint: HTML inside foreignObject re-lays out based on @container width while container-type on a g element has no effect.

features.name: hyphens:auto with lang in foreignObject text
features.support_note: depends on per-language dictionaries; Chrome desktop coverage varies; SVG text never hyphenates
features.showcase_hint: Narrow HTML paragraph with lang="en" and hyphens:auto shows hyphenated line breaks; same text without lang does not.

features.name: @import inside SVG style element
features.support_note: all browsers; blocked in img/secure mode
features.showcase_hint: Shapes styled by rules from an @import-ed stylesheet and a Google Fonts @import for SVG text.

features.name: !important in SVG styling
features.showcase_hint: A stylesheet rule with fill:purple !important beats the element's inline style attribute and a SMIL/CSS animated fill.

features.name: :lang() pseudo-class styling
features.showcase_hint: text:lang(fr) turns blue and text:lang(de) turns red purely from lang attributes inherited through groups.

features.name: light-dark() with color-scheme
features.showcase_hint: fill: light-dark(#222,#eee) flips per theme without media queries; color-scheme: light dark on root enables it.

features.name: :link/:visited/:hover/:focus on SVG a
features.support_note: all browsers; :visited limited to colour-only changes
features.showcase_hint: Linked text turns underlined and brighter on hover, visited links show a different colour, keyboard focus draws an outline.

features.name: @media (prefers-contrast: more)
features.showcase_hint: Thin grey gridlines become thick black lines when the OS increased-contrast setting is enabled.

features.name: :root theming scope (svg root vs html root)
features.showcase_hint: Standalone SVG: :root{--bg:navy} styles the svg element; inline in HTML the same rule targets html and the svg inherits the variable.

features.name: @supports feature queries
features.showcase_hint: Shape uses fill: context-stroke only inside @supports; a label reads 'fallback' in browsers lacking the feature.

features.name: :target with fragment links inside SVG
features.showcase_hint: Clicking an internal #id link highlights the targeted group with a glow via g:target selector.

features.name: SVG-namespace audio element
features.showcase_hint: Would play a sound file referenced from within SVG; in practice nothing happens.

features.name: SVG-namespace canvas element
features.showcase_hint: Would expose a 2D drawing surface inside SVG; renders nothing in browsers.

features.name: SVG-namespace iframe element
features.showcase_hint: Would embed an external document inside the SVG viewport; renders nothing in browsers.

features.name: SVG-namespace video element
features.support_note: no browser implements SVG-namespace video; use foreignObject with HTML video
features.showcase_hint: Would show a playing video in an SVG rectangle; renders nothing in browsers.

features.name: image-rendering crisp-edges
features.support_note: Chromium treats as pixelated; Safari needs -webkit-optimize-contrast; Firefox native
features.showcase_hint: Upscaled line-art raster keeps sharp edges; side-by-side with pixelated reveals engine differences.

features.name: SVG 1.1 optimizeSpeed/optimizeQuality keywords
features.support_note: legacy keywords mapped to pixelated/auto or ignored; removed from SVG 2 in favour of CSS values
features.showcase_hint: optimizeSpeed on an upscaled raster shows pixelated output in Chrome/Firefox (legacy mapping); optimizeQuality looks like auto.

features.name: image-rendering pixelated
features.showcase_hint: Upscaled pixel-art sprite with crisp, blocky nearest-neighbour pixels instead of interpolation blur.

features.name: animated length baseVal/animVal on geometry attributes
features.showcase_hint: Slider updates circle.r.baseVal.value and the circle resizes live.

features.name: getPointAtLength()
features.showcase_hint: Evenly spaced dots placed along a curve by sampling points at fixed distances.

features.name: getTotalLength()
features.support_note: all browsers on all basic shapes
features.showcase_hint: Script sets stroke-dasharray to the measured length producing an exact single-dash outline.

features.name: isPointInFill()
features.showcase_hint: Mouse position dot turns green when inside the star's fill region per fill-rule, red outside.

features.name: getBBox() geometry bounding box
features.showcase_hint: Dashed rect drawn from getBBox hugs a curve's geometry, excluding stroke width and control points.

features.name: path data attribute d
features.showcase_hint: Same shape given in verbose and compact d syntax renders identically.

features.name: pathLength normalisation
features.support_note: all browsers; SVG 2 extends it to all basic shapes
features.showcase_hint: Two differently sized paths with pathLength='100' and stroke-dasharray='25' both show exactly four equal dashes.

features.name: polygon points list parsing
features.showcase_hint: Star polygon from a points list mixing comma and whitespace separators; changing one coordinate visibly moves a vertex.

features.name: rect corner radius rx
features.showcase_hint: Rectangle with visibly rounded corners; rx alone yields circular corners because ry defaults to rx.

features.name: ellipse rx/ry auto (circle fallback)
features.support_note: Chrome and Firefox render a circle; Safari treats a missing or auto radius as not rendered
features.showcase_hint: ellipse with only ry='40' renders as a circle of radius 40 instead of disappearing.

features.name: elliptical arc A/a
features.showcase_hint: Arc segment with rx != ry showing an elliptical curve between two points.

features.name: cubic Bezier curveto C/c
features.showcase_hint: S-curve with both control points drawn as helper dots and handles.

features.name: horizontal lineto H/h
features.showcase_hint: Perfectly horizontal steps drawn with single-number H/h commands.

features.name: lineto L/l
features.showcase_hint: Straight segments between listed points forming a polyline-like path.

features.name: moveto M/m
features.showcase_hint: Several M commands start separate strokes at explicit absolute positions within one path.

features.name: quadratic Bezier curveto Q/q
features.showcase_hint: Single-control-point arch with the control point shown as a helper dot.

features.name: smooth cubic curveto S/s
features.showcase_hint: Wave of C followed by S segments with perfectly tangent-continuous joins.

features.name: smooth quadratic curveto T/t
features.showcase_hint: Sine-like wave built from one Q and a chain of T endpoints only.

features.name: vertical lineto V/v
features.showcase_hint: Perfectly vertical steps drawn with single-number V/v commands.

features.name: closepath Z/z
features.showcase_hint: Two identical open outlines, one ending with Z showing a closing edge and mitred corner.

features.name: large-arc and sweep flags four combinations
features.showcase_hint: Four arcs between the same two points (00, 01, 10, 11) tracing the four candidate arcs of the two ellipses.

features.name: too-small arc radii scaled up
features.showcase_hint: A '1 1' arc between points 100 apart renders as a semicircle of radius 50, not a tiny arc.

features.name: implicit command repetition (M implies L)
features.showcase_hint: 'M10 10 50 50 90 10' draws a V-shape without any explicit L command.

features.name: multiple subpaths in one path
features.showcase_hint: One path element rendering a ring (outer and inner subpath) plus disjoint islands.

features.name: lowercase relative vs uppercase absolute coordinates
features.showcase_hint: Same glyph drawn with uppercase and lowercase commands overlaps exactly; changing one relative value shifts everything after it.

features.name: S reflects previous C/S second control point
features.showcase_hint: Overlay of reflected control handle shows S's first control mirrors the prior segment's last control.

features.name: T reflects previous Q/T control point
features.showcase_hint: Chain of T commands produces alternating symmetric humps from a single initial Q, reflected controls drawn as dots.

features.name: zero-length segment with round cap renders dot
features.showcase_hint: Dotted trail from 'M10 10h0 M30 10h0' with stroke-linecap round; butt cap draws nothing.

features.name: path d as CSS property
features.showcase_hint: A path with no d attribute is drawn purely from 'd: path("M...")' in a stylesheet.

features.name: circle element
features.showcase_hint: A perfect circle defined by cx/cy/r, stroked and filled.

features.name: ellipse element
features.showcase_hint: A wide flat oval with rx much larger than ry, next to a tall narrow one.

features.name: line element
features.showcase_hint: A straight stroked segment from (x1,y1) to (x2,y2) with visible line caps.

features.name: path element
features.showcase_hint: A freeform outline mixing lines, cubic and quadratic curves and arcs drawn from one d string.

features.name: polygon element
features.showcase_hint: A closed hexagon whose last point automatically joins the first with a proper stroke join.

features.name: polyline element
features.showcase_hint: An open zig-zag stroke through the listed points, with no closing segment.

features.name: rect element
features.showcase_hint: An axis-aligned rectangle positioned by x/y with width/height, filled and stroked.

features.name: fill-rule property
features.showcase_hint: Same self-intersecting star rendered twice with nonzero and evenodd gives different interior holes.

features.name: shape-rendering property
features.support_note: all browsers; exact rasterisation differs per engine
features.showcase_hint: Same diagonal-edged shape rendered with each value shows differing anti-aliasing when zoomed.

features.name: isPointInStroke()
features.showcase_hint: Indicator lights only when the pointer is within the stroke band of a thick outline.

features.name: pathLength animated number
features.showcase_hint: Script reads pathLength.baseVal to compute dash offsets shown as a progress ring.

features.name: getPathData()/setPathData() path data API
features.support_note: No browser ships it; polyfill only
features.showcase_hint: Feature-detect shows getPathData undefined; polyfill-normalised segments listed for contrast.

features.name: getPathSegAtLength()
features.support_note: Still in Chrome, Firefox and Safari but removed from SVG 2
features.showcase_hint: Highlighting the segment index under the cursor, labelled as legacy API.

features.name: pathSegList / SVGPathSeg interfaces
features.support_note: Removed from Chrome 48 and WebKit; Firefox retains; dropped from SVG 2
features.showcase_hint: Feature-detect panel shows 'pathSegList: unsupported' in Chromium while Firefox lists segments.

features.name: polygon.points SVGPointList manipulation
features.showcase_hint: Clicking appends an SVGPoint to polygon.points and a new vertex appears.

features.name: circle cx/cy centre
features.showcase_hint: Same-radius circles at different cx/cy values form a diagonal chain.

features.name: circle radius r
features.showcase_hint: Several concentric circles with increasing r values producing nested rings.

features.name: ellipse cx/cy centre
features.showcase_hint: Two ellipses with the same radii but different cx/cy sit apart.

features.name: ellipse horizontal radius rx
features.showcase_hint: Wide flat ellipse where rx clearly exceeds ry.

features.name: ellipse vertical radius ry
features.showcase_hint: Tall narrow ellipse where ry clearly exceeds rx.

features.name: line x1/y1/x2/y2 endpoints
features.showcase_hint: Diagonal stroked line whose endpoints are marked with small dots at the given coordinates.

features.name: polyline points list
features.showcase_hint: Points given with commas, spaces and newlines mixed still render the same polyline.

features.name: rect vertical corner radius ry
features.showcase_hint: Rectangle whose corners are elliptical (rx != ry), showing distinct horizontal and vertical rounding.

features.name: rect width/height size
features.showcase_hint: Row of rects with growing width and height values; the last is a tall slab.

features.name: rect x/y position
features.showcase_hint: Three identical rects at different x/y values sit at visibly different spots on a grid.

features.name: bearing commands B/b
features.support_note: Dropped from SVG 2 candidate; no browser
features.showcase_hint: A d string using B renders only the prefix before the unknown command.

features.name: Catmull-Rom commands R/r
features.support_note: Removed from SVG 2 draft; no browser
features.showcase_hint: A d string using R stops rendering at the R token.

features.name: rect rx/ry auto keyword
features.showcase_hint: rx='auto' ry='20' renders round corners equal to ry, proving auto copies the other radius.

features.name: CSS units (mm, cm, in, em) in geometry attributes
features.showcase_hint: Rects with width='1in', '2.54cm' and '96px' render exactly the same size.

features.name: arc with equal endpoints is skipped
features.showcase_hint: A single A back to the start point draws nothing; a full circle needs two half arcs.

features.name: arc flags parsed without separators
features.showcase_hint: 'a25 25 0 0150 0' renders the same arc as the spaced form.

features.name: negative arc radii use absolute value
features.showcase_hint: Arc with rx='-40' renders identically to rx='40'.

features.name: arc x-axis-rotation parameter
features.showcase_hint: Same elliptical arc at rotation 0, 30 and 60 degrees visibly tilts the ellipse.

features.name: zero arc radius degenerates to line
features.showcase_hint: An A command with rx=0 draws a straight segment to the endpoint.

features.name: bbox ignores stroke and off-curve control points
features.showcase_hint: Thick stroke overflows the drawn bbox; a Bezier's far control point lies outside it.

features.name: Z joins stroke ends, open path gets caps
features.showcase_hint: Thick-stroked triangle: with Z the start corner is mitred; with L back to start it shows two butt caps.

features.name: empty or missing d/points disables rendering
features.showcase_hint: path with d='' shows no stroke and no marker even with a thick stroke; a sibling with data shows both.

features.name: fill implicitly closes unclosed subpaths
features.showcase_hint: Open path with fill shows filled region while the stroke shows a gap at the closing edge.

features.name: line ignores fill
features.showcase_hint: line with fill='red' and no stroke renders nothing; adding stroke makes it appear.

features.name: negative width/height/r treated as zero
features.support_note: all browsers; SVG 1.1 called it an error, SVG 2 treats as zero
features.showcase_hint: A rect with width='-50' is simply absent while its neighbours render.

features.name: path data error renders up to error
features.showcase_hint: d containing an invalid token halfway renders only the first half of the shape.

features.name: path data must begin with M/m
features.showcase_hint: d='L50 50 L90 10' renders nothing; prefixing 'M10 10' makes the V appear.

features.name: compact number syntax in path data
features.showcase_hint: 'M.5.5l1e2-.5' renders correctly, proving leading-dot, exponent and sign-separated parsing.

features.name: pathLength on rect/circle/ellipse/line/polyline/polygon
features.showcase_hint: Circle with pathLength='100' and stroke-dasharray='75 25' shows exactly three quarters of its ring.

features.name: odd coordinate count drops trailing value
features.support_note: all browsers render up to last complete pair
features.showcase_hint: points='0,0 100,0 100,100 50' renders a triangle, ignoring the dangling 50.

features.name: points parse error renders prefix
features.showcase_hint: A points list containing a stray letter mid-way renders only the coordinates before the error.

features.name: basic shapes as equivalent paths
features.showcase_hint: rect, circle and their equivalent path definitions overlaid render pixel-identically including dash starts.

features.name: polyline fill closes area but stroke stays open
features.showcase_hint: Filled polyline shows a closed fill region while the stroke visibly lacks the closing edge.

features.name: percentage r resolves against normalized diagonal
features.showcase_hint: r='50%' in a 400x100 viewport renders a circle whose radius is neither 200 nor 50 but ~146.

features.name: rx/ry clamped to half size
features.showcase_hint: rx='1000' on a 100x40 rect renders a pill/stadium shape, not a broken shape.

features.name: percentage x/y/width/height on rect
features.showcase_hint: width='50%' rect spans exactly half the viewport width regardless of viewBox size.

features.name: relative m after Z is relative to subpath start
features.showcase_hint: Row of identical squares from 'M0 0h20v20h-20z m30 0 ...', each offset from the previous subpath start.

features.name: S/T after non-curve uses current point as control
features.showcase_hint: T directly after L renders a straight line; S after L renders a curve with one collapsed control.

features.name: dash pattern origin per basic shape
features.support_note: all browsers (circle starts at rightmost point, rect at top-left after rounding)
features.showcase_hint: Dashed circle begins its first dash at 3 o'clock; dashed rect starts at the top-left corner.

features.name: subpath winding direction creates holes under nonzero
features.showcase_hint: Two nested squares: reversed inner winding produces a hole under nonzero, same winding fills solid.

features.name: zero-length segment with square cap renders square
features.showcase_hint: Same zero-length path with linecap square shows axis-aligned squares instead of dots.

features.name: zero width/height/r disables rendering
features.showcase_hint: Side-by-side rects where the width='0' one leaves an empty gap even with a thick stroke.

features.name: var() in geometry properties
features.showcase_hint: Changing one --radius custom property on the root resizes every circle at once.

features.name: CSS transition between path() values
features.support_note: Chrome 88, Firefox 97, Safari 17; requires matching command structure
features.showcase_hint: Hovering morphs a triangle into a square by interpolating two path() strings with equal segment counts.

features.name: percentage geometry values via CSS
features.showcase_hint: rect styled 'width: 50%' tracks half the viewport as the SVG resizes.

features.name: CSS transitions/animations on geometry properties
features.showcase_hint: Circle radius and rect corner rx animate smoothly on hover via CSS transition.

features.name: cx geometry property
features.showcase_hint: Circle horizontal centre set from CSS.

features.name: cy geometry property
features.showcase_hint: Circle vertical centre set from CSS.

features.name: height geometry property
features.showcase_hint: Rect height animated with CSS transition.

features.name: r geometry property
features.showcase_hint: Circle grows on hover through a CSS r transition.

features.name: rx geometry property
features.showcase_hint: Rect corners round via CSS rx.

features.name: ry geometry property
features.showcase_hint: Rect corner vertical radius set from CSS differs from rx.

features.name: width geometry property
features.showcase_hint: Rect width changes on :hover via CSS.

features.name: x geometry property
features.showcase_hint: Rect moves horizontally when a CSS rule sets x.

features.name: y geometry property
features.showcase_hint: Rect moves vertically when CSS sets y.

features.name: fill-rule evenodd
features.showcase_hint: Pentagram with a hollow centre pentagon; concentric rings alternate filled and hollow regardless of winding.

features.name: fill-rule nonzero
features.showcase_hint: Pentagram fully filled including the centre; concentric same-direction rings fill solid.

features.name: shape-rendering auto
features.showcase_hint: Default smoothly anti-aliased circle edge.

features.name: shape-rendering crispEdges
features.showcase_hint: Hairline grid snaps to whole pixels without grey blur; a rotated rect shows stair-stepped edges beside a smooth copy.

features.name: shape-rendering geometricPrecision
features.showcase_hint: Smooth anti-aliased edges identical to auto, contrasted with crispEdges neighbour.

features.name: shape-rendering optimizeSpeed
features.support_note: Chrome and Safari treat as crispEdges; Firefox may still anti-alias
features.showcase_hint: Circle edge turns jagged (aliased) in Chromium when zoomed.

features.name: Line-drawing effect with dasharray = path length
features.showcase_hint: Signature path appears to draw itself as stroke-dashoffset animates from total length to 0.

features.name: url() paint with fallback colour or none
features.showcase_hint: fill="url(#missing) orange" renders orange because the reference is broken; fill="url(#missing)" alone renders nothing.

features.name: CSS Color syntaxes as paint (rgb/hsl, #rrggbbaa, oklch, lab, color())
features.support_note: all browsers; display-p3 colours need a wide-gamut screen
features.showcase_hint: Row of swatches filled with hsl(), oklch(), lab(), color(display-p3) values, vivid out-of-sRGB colours next to sRGB equivalents.

features.name: color property (currentColor source)
features.showcase_hint: Group with color=teal makes all descendants using currentColor render teal; nested group overrides color to orange.

features.name: color-interpolation sRGB/linearRGB
features.support_note: Firefox honours linearRGB for gradients; Chrome and Safari ignore it
features.showcase_hint: Red-to-green gradient twice; in Firefox the linearRGB version has a brighter, less muddy midpoint.

features.name: cursor property on SVG elements
features.showcase_hint: Hovering different shapes shows pointer, crosshair, grab and not-allowed cursors.

features.name: display: none vs visibility
features.showcase_hint: display=none removes the shape from the group bbox outline, hit-testing and tspan text flow, unlike visibility=hidden.

features.name: fill paint property
features.showcase_hint: Same shape repeated with different fill values (keyword, hex, none, url) so the interior paint changes while geometry stays identical.

features.name: fill-opacity
features.showcase_hint: Shape with fill-opacity 0.4 and opaque stroke: background shows through the interior while the outline stays solid.

features.name: isolation: isolate
features.showcase_hint: Blended child inside an isolated group no longer mixes with backdrop shapes outside the group, but still blends within it.

features.name: mix-blend-mode on SVG elements
features.showcase_hint: Overlapping cyan, magenta and yellow circles with multiply produce subtractive colour mixing where they intersect.

features.name: opacity (group compositing vs per-element)
features.showcase_hint: Same overlapping circles twice: per-element opacity shows darker overlaps, group opacity 0.5 shows uniform translucency with no seams.

features.name: overflow on nested viewports
features.showcase_hint: Nested <svg> with a circle extending beyond its width/height: hidden clips it, visible lets it spill.

features.name: paint-order
features.showcase_hint: Two identical shapes with thick strokes: normal order shows stroke covering half the fill, paint-order stroke shows full fill on top.

features.name: stroke paint property
features.showcase_hint: Outline painted with a colour, gradient or pattern, centred on the geometry edge, clearly distinct from the fill.

features.name: stroke-dasharray lengths
features.showcase_hint: Lines with dasharray 4, 10 2, 20 5 5 5 show dashed patterns of different rhythm; "none" line is solid.

features.name: stroke-dashoffset (incl. negative)
features.showcase_hint: Stacked dashed lines with offsets 0, 5, -5 show the pattern shifted left/right relative to the start point.

features.name: stroke-linecap butt/round/square
features.showcase_hint: Three identical thick lines over a thin guide: butt ends flush, round and square ends extend half the width past.

features.name: stroke-linejoin miter/round/bevel
features.support_note: miter, round, bevel in all browsers
features.showcase_hint: Same zigzag polyline three times showing sharp, rounded and chamfered corners.

features.name: stroke-miterlimit
features.showcase_hint: Sharp chevrons with miterlimit 1, 4 (default) and 10: the spike appears only when the limit is high enough, else bevel.

features.name: stroke-opacity
features.showcase_hint: Thick semi-transparent stroke over an opaque fill: the inner half of the stroke visibly tints over the fill colour.

features.name: stroke-width in user units
features.showcase_hint: Lines at stroke-width 0.5, 1, 4, 12 showing thickness; the stroke visibly straddles the geometry edge of a rect.

features.name: text-rendering hint
features.support_note: optimizeLegibility affects ligatures/kerning; geometricPrecision only Chrome disables hinting
features.showcase_hint: Same word rendered with optimizeLegibility (ligature fi, kerning AV) vs optimizeSpeed with them absent.

features.name: visibility hidden vs visible
features.showcase_hint: Hidden shape leaves its space in a group bounding box (drawn via getBBox outline) while being invisible.

features.name: context-fill paint (markers)
features.support_note: markers in Firefox 111+, Safari 17.4+, Chrome since 2024; <use> less consistent
features.showcase_hint: One arrowhead <marker fill="context-fill"> renders red on a red path and blue on a blue path.

features.name: Cross-using context paints (fill=context-stroke)
features.showcase_hint: Marker filled with fill=context-stroke so a solid arrowhead matches the line colour while the line itself has no fill.

features.name: currentColor paint keyword
features.showcase_hint: Icon using fill=currentColor changes colour when the CSS color of its ancestor (even an HTML element) changes.

features.name: fill: none (unfilled)
features.showcase_hint: Outlined-only shape where the background shows through the interior; adjacent shape with default black fill for contrast.

features.name: Paint server reference url(#id)
features.showcase_hint: Shape filled with a gradient or pattern via fill=url(#id); the same reference used on stroke draws a patterned outline.

features.name: paint-order with markers first
features.showcase_hint: Path with large markers: with markers painted first the stroke visibly runs over the marker shapes.

features.name: context-stroke paint (markers)
features.support_note: markers in Firefox 111+, Safari 17.4+, Chrome since 2024; <use> less consistent
features.showcase_hint: Marker outline colour matches each host path's stroke colour with a single shared <marker>.

features.name: vector-effect: non-scaling-stroke
features.support_note: all browsers; the only vector-effect value implemented anywhere
features.showcase_hint: Scaled group where one child keeps a 1px hairline stroke while its twin's stroke scales up with the transform.

features.name: Closepath Z produces a join instead of caps
features.showcase_hint: Two triangles: one ending with Z shows a mitred corner, the other returning to start without Z shows a notched corner with caps.

features.name: context-fill/context-stroke inside <use> references
features.support_note: Firefox and Chrome support in <use>; Safari only in markers
features.showcase_hint: Symbol whose sub-parts use context-fill and context-stroke; <use fill=green stroke=black> colours parts differently from <use fill=red>.

features.name: Recolouring <use> icons via CSS color
features.showcase_hint: Same symbol instantiated by several <use> elements, each a different colour set only through CSS color on the <use>.

features.name: Caps applied to each dash
features.showcase_hint: Dashed line with round caps: each dash grows rounded ends and short gaps close up compared with butt caps.

features.name: Initial values fill black, stroke none
features.showcase_hint: Shapes with no paint attributes render solid black with no outline, proving initial values fill:black and stroke:none.

features.name: Dotted line via zero dashes and round caps
features.showcase_hint: stroke-dasharray="0 12" with stroke-linecap=round produces a row of perfect circular dots.

features.name: Half-pixel offset for crisp 1px strokes
features.showcase_hint: 1px line at y=10 renders as a blurry 2px grey band; the twin at y=10.5 is a single sharp pixel row.

features.name: Simulating inside/outside strokes
features.showcase_hint: Inside stroke via clip-path to the shape itself, outside stroke via paint-order:stroke with doubled width; compared with centred stroke.

features.name: Marching-ants selection outline
features.showcase_hint: Dashed rectangle whose dashes crawl continuously via a looping stroke-dashoffset animation.

features.name: Multiple comma-separated fill/stroke paint layers (rolled back)
features.support_note: rolled back from SVG 2 Fill & Stroke drafts; no browser implements
features.showcase_hint: fill="url(#pattern), red" would layer paints; browsers treat the value as invalid and fall back to black.

features.name: Odd-count dasharray doubled
features.showcase_hint: dasharray "10 5 2" renders as 10 5 2 10 5 2 with dashes and gaps swapping roles, next to an explicit six-value twin.

features.name: opacity 0 keeps hit-testing unlike visibility hidden
features.showcase_hint: Invisible opacity=0 rect still shows a pointer cursor and fires hover; visibility=hidden twin does not.

features.name: Circular progress ring via dash on circle
features.showcase_hint: Circle with dasharray = circumference and varying dashoffset shows 25/50/75% arcs, rotated -90 to start at top.

features.name: Translucent stroke shows fill beneath its inner half
features.showcase_hint: stroke-opacity 0.5 shows a two-tone band (over fill vs over background), while opacity 0.5 on the whole shape does not.

features.name: Gradient or pattern on stroke
features.showcase_hint: Thick outline painted with a rainbow gradient or hatch pattern while the interior stays flat or unfilled.

features.name: Stroke distorted by non-uniform transforms
features.showcase_hint: Circle inside scale(3,1) shows a stroke thick on left/right and thin on top/bottom; non-scaling-stroke version stays uniform.

features.name: Blending inline SVG content against HTML backdrop
features.support_note: all browsers; root <svg> may form its own stacking context depending on styling
features.showcase_hint: Inline SVG shape with multiply darkens the HTML gradient behind it; with isolation on the svg it does not.

features.name: Child re-enabling visibility inside hidden parent
features.showcase_hint: Group with visibility=hidden shows only the one child that sets visibility=visible.

features.name: Zero-length subpaths render dots with round/square caps
features.showcase_hint: Path "M10 10 Z M30 10 Z" with round caps draws a row of dots; with butt caps nothing appears.

features.name: <color-profile> element and color-profile property
features.support_note: removed in SVG 2; Chrome dropped it, Firefox and Safari never implemented
features.showcase_hint: Image renders in the document's default colour space regardless of a color-profile element; no visible effect.

features.name: <cursor> element
features.support_note: removed in SVG 2; never implemented by browsers
features.showcase_hint: cursor=url(#svgcursor) referencing a <cursor> element shows the default arrow, proving it is ignored.

features.name: <solidcolor> paint server (solid-color / solid-opacity)
features.support_note: from SVG Tiny 1.2, dropped from SVG 2 CR; no browser support
features.showcase_hint: Shape referencing url(#solid) renders the fallback colour, showing the element is unsupported.

features.name: buffered-rendering (removed; use will-change)
features.support_note: removed in SVG 2; Chrome dropped it, WebKit still parses; will-change replaces it
features.showcase_hint: No visible change; buffered-rendering="static" renders identically to auto.

features.name: color-rendering hint
features.support_note: removed in SVG 2; no visible effect in browsers
features.showcase_hint: Gradient with color-rendering=optimizeSpeed renders identically to auto, demonstrating the hint is inert.

features.name: enable-background / BackgroundImage
features.support_note: removed in SVG 2; never implemented by browsers; isolation replaces it
features.showcase_hint: Filter using in=BackgroundImage yields a transparent result, proving enable-background is ignored.

features.name: stroke-alignment inner/outer
features.support_note: moved from SVG 2 into SVG Strokes module; no browser implements
features.showcase_hint: stroke-alignment=inner has no effect; the outline stays centred on the edge, identical to the twin without it.

features.name: stroke-dashcorner / stroke-dash-justify
features.support_note: SVG Strokes module; no browser implements
features.showcase_hint: Dashed rectangle where corners would receive centred dashes; browsers show ordinary corner clipping of dashes.

features.name: z-index (dropped from SVG 2)
features.support_note: deferred out of SVG 2; no browser reorders SVG by z-index
features.showcase_hint: A rect with z-index: 10 stays under a later sibling; document order wins.

features.name: Custom image cursor via url()
features.support_note: all browsers for PNG; SVG cursor images unsupported in Safari, limited in Chrome
features.showcase_hint: Hovering a shape shows a custom PNG cursor with hotspot, falling back to a keyword.

features.name: child / child(n) paint values (deferred)
features.support_note: deferred from SVG 2; no browser implements
features.showcase_hint: A shape with fill="child" would use its child paint server; browsers treat it as invalid and paint black.

features.name: color-mix() as paint
features.showcase_hint: Gradient-like row of shapes whose fill is color-mix(in oklab, red, blue X%) at increasing percentages.

features.name: icc-color() ICC profile paint
features.support_note: removed in SVG 2; never implemented by browsers
features.showcase_hint: fill="#f00 icc-color(profile, 0,1,1)" renders the sRGB fallback only, showing the ICC part is ignored.

features.name: Explicit inherit of paint
features.showcase_hint: Child inside a red group with fill=inherit renders red while a sibling with fill=blue renders blue.

features.name: light-dark() paint for colour schemes
features.showcase_hint: Shape whose fill flips between two colours when the page colour-scheme toggles, without media queries.

features.name: Alpha colour syntaxes (rgba, hsla, #rrggbbaa)
features.showcase_hint: Overlapping shapes filled with rgba/#rrggbbaa colours show translucent overlap without any fill-opacity attribute.

features.name: System colour keywords (Canvas, CanvasText, Highlight, AccentColor)
features.support_note: AccentColor missing in Firefox on some platforms
features.showcase_hint: Shapes filled with AccentColor/Highlight/CanvasText take on the operating-system theme colours.

features.name: transparent colour keyword as paint
features.showcase_hint: Shape with fill=transparent is invisible but still receives pointer events, unlike fill=none; hover changes its colour.

features.name: difference / exclusion blend
features.showcase_hint: White text with difference blending inverts against whatever colour it overlaps.

features.name: Non-separable blends (hue, saturation, color, luminosity)
features.showcase_hint: Grey photo-like gradient under a coloured circle with mode color takes the circle's hue while keeping its own shading.

features.name: Additive blend modes (screen, lighten, plus-lighter)
features.showcase_hint: RGB circles on black with screen blending produce white at the triple overlap.

features.name: overflow: scroll / auto behave as hidden in SVG
features.support_note: all browsers; no scrollbars on SVG viewports
features.showcase_hint: Nested svg with overflow=scroll clips its spilling circle exactly like hidden, with no scrollbar.

features.name: paint-order: stroke on text (outline behind fill)
features.showcase_hint: Text with thick contrasting stroke stays legible because the stroke is drawn beneath the fill glyphs.

features.name: Percentage dash lengths
features.showcase_hint: stroke-dasharray="5% 2%" dash length changes with viewBox size across two differently sized viewports.

features.name: Round caps
features.showcase_hint: Line ends are semicircles extending half the stroke width beyond the endpoints.

features.name: Square caps
features.showcase_hint: Line ends extend half the stroke width as squares, visibly longer than the butt-capped twin.

features.name: arcs join
features.support_note: no browser implements; treated as invalid, renders miter
features.showcase_hint: Curved thick path where arcs would continue the outer curvature at joins; browsers render plain miter corners.

features.name: Bevel joins
features.showcase_hint: Corners are cut flat across, visibly chamfered compared with miter.

features.name: miter-clip join
features.support_note: Firefox only; Chrome and Safari fall back to miter
features.showcase_hint: Very sharp angle exceeding miterlimit: miter-clip shows a clipped spike, while miter falls to bevel.

features.name: Round joins
features.showcase_hint: Corners of a thick polyline are circular arcs.

features.name: Zero stroke-width suppresses stroke
features.showcase_hint: Shape with stroke=red but stroke-width=0 shows no outline; markers still render on the path.

features.name: stroke-width with CSS units (em, px, mm)
features.showcase_hint: stroke-width=0.5em thickens when font-size on the ancestor increases; a 1mm stroke stays physical.

features.name: stroke-width as percentage of viewport diagonal
features.showcase_hint: stroke-width=5% differs between two nested svgs with different viewBox sizes.

features.name: stroke: none (default)
features.showcase_hint: Shape with stroke-width set but stroke none renders no outline; toggling to a colour reveals the outline.

features.name: vector-effect: fixed-position
features.support_note: no browser implements; at-risk in spec
features.showcase_hint: Shape that should ignore ancestor translation moves with it.

features.name: vector-effect: non-rotation
features.support_note: no browser implements; at-risk in spec
features.showcase_hint: Label inside a rotated group that should stay upright rotates with it.

features.name: vector-effect: non-scaling-size
features.support_note: no browser implements; at-risk in spec
features.showcase_hint: Marker-like shape that should keep screen size under scale instead grows, showing the value is ignored.

features.name: vector-effect viewport / screen reference modifiers
features.support_note: no browser parses the viewport/screen keywords; value becomes invalid
features.showcase_hint: "non-scaling-stroke viewport" is rejected, so the stroke scales again while the plain keyword twin stays thin.

features.name: visibility: collapse
features.support_note: all browsers treat it as hidden for SVG
features.showcase_hint: Shape with visibility=collapse disappears exactly like hidden.

features.name: gradientTransform
features.showcase_hint: A horizontal gradient rotated 30 degrees or skewed via gradientTransform while the shape itself is untransformed.

features.name: href inheritance between gradients
features.support_note: all browsers inherit stops and attributes through href
features.showcase_hint: A gradient with no stops references another and renders its stops but with its own vector or spreadMethod.

features.name: Gradient vector x1/y1/x2/y2
features.showcase_hint: Same stops rendered with horizontal, vertical, diagonal and shortened (x2=50%) vectors, showing the axis and where the pad region starts.

features.name: Pattern href inheritance
features.showcase_hint: A child pattern with no content but a different patternTransform or tile size reuses the referenced pattern's tile artwork.

features.name: patternTransform rotates/scales the tile grid
features.showcase_hint: Hatching pattern rotated 45 degrees into diagonal stripes while the filled rect stays axis-aligned.

features.name: pattern viewBox scaling
features.showcase_hint: Tile artwork authored in 0-100 coordinates fits an arbitrary 24x24 tile via viewBox without changing content.

features.name: Tile size width/height
features.showcase_hint: The same dot drawn in 10, 20 and 40-unit tiles, so dot spacing changes while dot size stays fixed.

features.name: Radial centre and radius cx/cy/r
features.showcase_hint: Same stops with the centre moved to a corner and r shrunk to 25%, so rings are off-centre and the pad colour fills the rest.

features.name: Focal radius fr
features.support_note: Chrome 85+ and Safari honour fr; Firefox support lagged, verify in target version
features.showcase_hint: A ring gradient: a solid inner disc of the first colour (radius fr) before the ramp begins, unlike fr=0.

features.name: Focal point fx/fy
features.showcase_hint: A sphere whose highlight sits upper-left of centre while the outer rim remains a full circle, the classic glossy-ball look.

features.name: offset as number or percentage
features.showcase_hint: Two identical ramps, one using offset=0.5 and one offset=50%, render the same; a third with offsets bunched near 90% shows an asymmetric ramp.

features.name: gradientUnits userSpaceOnUse
features.showcase_hint: A bar chart where bars share one canvas-wide gradient, taller bars reaching lighter colours; the bbox twin shows every bar with a full ramp.

features.name: spreadMethod reflect
features.showcase_hint: A short vector produces mirrored back-and-forth colour bands with no hard seams across the whole shape.

features.name: spreadMethod repeat
features.showcase_hint: A short vector repeats as sawtooth stripes with hard edges where the last stop jumps back to the first.

features.name: patternContentUnits objectBoundingBox
features.showcase_hint: A circle with r=0.1 inside the tile scales with the filled shape's bbox, appearing as an ellipse on a wide rect.

features.name: patternUnits userSpaceOnUse
features.showcase_hint: Tiles stay a constant absolute size across shapes and align continuously across touching shapes.

features.name: Radial reflect with focal offset

features.name: Gradient-filled text

features.name: Halftone dots via patterns

features.name: Mesh gradient emulation with blurred blobs

features.name: Pattern content filled with another pattern

features.name: Text inside pattern tiles

features.name: radialGradient element

features.name: SVGPatternElement animated attributes

features.name: SVGRadialGradientElement cx/cy/r/fx/fy/fr SVGAnimatedLength

features.name: Tile origin x/y offset

features.name: Checkerboard and transparency-grid tiles

features.name: Banding and dither via feTurbulence noise overlay

features.name: Multi-level href chains and attribute override

features.name: Linear referencing radial (stops only cross type)

features.name: bbox gradients per <use> instance

features.name: Duplicate offsets create hard edges

features.name: Stacking transparent radial gradients

features.name: Pattern-filled stroke

features.name: Pattern-filled text

features.name: Zero-length vector paints last stop colour

features.showcase_hint: A character drawn from a path outline in an SVG font; browsers show fallback font glyphs.

features.name: <glyphRef>
features.showcase_hint: Points at a glyph in an SVG font for altGlyph; no visible effect.

features.name: <hkern> horizontal kerning pair
features.support_note: removed in SVG 2; no current browser
features.showcase_hint: Tightened spacing between specific glyph pairs like AV in an SVG font; no effect today.

features.name: <missing-glyph> fallback
features.support_note: removed in SVG 2; no current browser
features.showcase_hint: A box or placeholder shape for characters absent from the SVG font; no effect today.

features.name: <tbreak> line break (SVG Tiny 1.2)
features.support_note: SVG Tiny 1.2 only; no current browser
features.showcase_hint: A forced line break inside textArea; no visible effect in browsers.

features.name: <textArea> wrapped text (SVG Tiny 1.2)
features.support_note: SVG Tiny 1.2 only; Opera Presto historically; no current browser
features.showcase_hint: Automatically line-wrapped text inside a rectangle; browsers render nothing.

features.name: <tref> text reference
features.support_note: removed in SVG 2; Chrome never implemented, Firefox and WebKit dropped it
features.showcase_hint: A <tref> shows no text; the referenced string must be copied into a <tspan>.

features.name: <vkern> vertical kerning pair
features.support_note: removed in SVG 2; no current browser
features.showcase_hint: Adjusted vertical spacing between glyph pairs in vertical SVG-font text; no effect today.

features.name: font shorthand
features.support_note: all browsers; presentation attribute in SVG 1.1, CSS everywhere
features.showcase_hint: font="italic bold 20px serif" applied in one attribute.

features.name: font-size-adjust x-height matching
features.showcase_hint: Two fallback fonts whose x-heights match a guide despite different design sizes.

features.name: font-variant-ligatures none / common
features.showcase_hint: fi and fl pairs fused in one line and separate in the next.

features.name: font-variant-numeric tabular / oldstyle
features.support_note: all browsers; font must provide tnum/onum
features.showcase_hint: Numeric table where tabular-nums digits line up and oldstyle-nums dip below baseline.

features.name: font-variation-settings variable axes
features.showcase_hint: Same word with wght and wdth axes swept across several copies.

features.name: font-width (font-stretch alias)
features.showcase_hint: Same condensed rendering as font-stretch using the newer property name.

features.name: glyph-orientation-horizontal (legacy)
features.support_note: removed in SVG 2; no browser implements
features.showcase_hint: Would rotate horizontal glyphs 90deg; renders as normal text everywhere.

features.name: glyph-orientation-vertical (legacy)
features.support_note: removed in SVG 2; Chrome and Safari map 0/90 only, Firefox ignores
features.showcase_hint: Vertical text with glyph-orientation-vertical="0" showing upright Latin where supported.

features.name: inline-size auto line wrapping
features.support_note: no browser implements SVG text wrapping
features.showcase_hint: Would wrap a long sentence into lines within 200 units; renders as single overflowing line everywhere.

features.name: kerning property / attribute (legacy)
features.support_note: removed in SVG 2; ignored by all browsers, use font-kerning
features.showcase_hint: kerning="0" has no visible effect; contrast with font-kerning:none which does.

features.name: shape-inside / shape-subtract / shape-padding text wrapping
features.showcase_hint: Would flow text inside a circle; renders as a single line everywhere.

features.name: text-decoration-fill / text-decoration-stroke
features.showcase_hint: An underline would be painted a different colour than the glyphs; browsers use the text fill.

features.name: text-overflow on SVG text
features.support_note: no browser applies text-overflow to SVG text
features.showcase_hint: Clipped text would end in an ellipsis; browsers cut it abruptly.

features.name: baseline-shift sub
features.showcase_hint: H2O with the 2 dropped and shrunk as a subscript.

features.name: baseline-shift super
features.showcase_hint: E=mc2 with the 2 raised as a superscript.

features.name: dominant-baseline central
features.showcase_hint: CJK or Latin text centred on the em-box middle, slightly different from middle.

features.name: dominant-baseline hanging
features.showcase_hint: Text hanging below a guide line, top of glyphs touching the line (Devanagari-style).

features.name: dominant-baseline ideographic / mathematical
features.support_note: all browsers; mathematical approximated in Safari
features.showcase_hint: CJK text sitting on the ideographic bottom edge versus Latin on the alphabetic baseline of the same guide.

features.name: dominant-baseline middle
features.showcase_hint: Text vertically centred on a guide line through its x-height midpoint.

features.name: dominant-baseline text-before-edge / text-after-edge
features.support_note: dropped from CSS Inline; Chrome and Safari still render, Firefox maps loosely
features.showcase_hint: Legacy value aligning glyph box top to guide; renders like text-top where supported.

features.name: dominant-baseline text-top / text-bottom
features.support_note: Chrome and Firefox honour; Safari incomplete
features.showcase_hint: Text whose em-box top or bottom edge aligns to a guide line.

features.name: text-anchor end
features.showcase_hint: Right-aligned numbers whose last glyph ends exactly at a guide line.

features.name: text-anchor middle
features.showcase_hint: Label centred symmetrically on a vertical guide line.

features.name: text-rendering geometricPrecision
features.support_note: all browsers; disables hinting, scales glyphs linearly
features.showcase_hint: Tiny text scaled up by transform stays proportionally identical rather than snapping to pixel grid.

features.name: legacy writing-mode tb / tb-rl / rl / lr
features.support_note: SVG 1.1 keywords still mapped to vertical-rl/horizontal-tb by all browsers
features.showcase_hint: writing-mode="tb" rendering identically to vertical-rl.

features.name: writing-mode vertical-lr
features.showcase_hint: Vertical column with successive lines stacking to the right, mirrored from vertical-rl.

features.name: Scripted clip-path via style.clipPath
