features.showcase_hint: Pointer position drives element.style.clipPath = `circle(60px at ${x}px ${y}px)`, creating a spotlight that follows the mouse.

features.name: clipPathUnits attribute
features.showcase_hint: Same clipPath on two differently sized rects: with the default userSpaceOnUse the window stays fixed in canvas coordinates, so one rect is barely clipped.

features.name: transform on clipPath and its children
features.showcase_hint: Two identical clips, one with transform=rotate(45) on the <clipPath>, show the same square window rotated into a diamond cutout of an unrotated image.

features.name: maskContentUnits attribute
features.showcase_hint: Mask content drawn in user space (default): a 40px white circle masks the same absolute area on both a small and a large target.

features.name: maskUnits attribute
features.showcase_hint: The same mask region attributes interpreted as bbox fractions (default) shrink-wrap each target; two targets of different sizes are masked proportionally.

features.name: mask width region size
features.support_note: all browsers; default region is -10%/120% of the bbox
features.showcase_hint: Default 120% region cuts off a mask whose content extends far past the target; width=200% keeps the overflow visible.

features.name: mask x region origin
features.showcase_hint: A mask with x=0.25 (bbox units) leaves the left quarter of the target fully invisible even though mask content covers it.

features.name: clipPathUnits=objectBoundingBox
features.showcase_hint: A 0..1 circle clip scales to each target: three rects of different sizes each show a proportionally sized elliptical cutout.

features.name: maskContentUnits=objectBoundingBox
features.showcase_hint: A 0..1 white circle scales with each target so every masked rect shows a proportionally sized soft oval.

features.name: SMIL-animated clipPath geometry (reveal/wipe)
features.showcase_hint: A rect inside the clipPath animates its width from 0 to full, wiping an image or text into view from left to right.

features.name: Clip applied to a group vs each child
features.showcase_hint: Side by side: a <g> clipped once to a circle shows one circular window over many shapes; per-child clipping shows a separate circle per shape.

features.name: HTML element clipped by an inline SVG clipPath
features.support_note: all browsers; clipPathUnits=objectBoundingBox recommended for HTML targets
features.showcase_hint:
An HTML or
uses clip-path:url(#svgClip) and appears cut to the SVG-defined shape.

features.name: clip-path on individual clipPath children
features.showcase_hint: One child rect inside the clipPath is itself clipped by a circle, so the clip region is a union of a full rect plus a rounded chunk.

features.name: CSS transition/animation between basic shapes
features.support_note: all browsers; shapes need the same function and vertex count
features.showcase_hint: On hover a polygon() clip morphs smoothly from a triangle to a hexagon-like shape; a circle() radius animates as a reveal.

features.name: Pointer events respect clip-path
features.showcase_hint: Hovering the clipped-away part of a rect does not change its colour or fire events; hovering inside the clip window does.

features.name: Processing order: filter, clip, mask, opacity
features.showcase_hint: A blurred, clipped, masked, half-opaque shape shows a hard clip edge on top of blur, and a fade on top of that.

features.name: Gradient-feathered mask edges (soft fade, vignette)
features.showcase_hint: An image fades to transparent at one edge via a white-to-black linearGradient in the mask; a radialGradient version produces a vignette.

features.name: HTML element masked by an SVG mask element
features.support_note: Firefox and Chrome 120+ support mask:url(#svgMask) on HTML; Safari limited
features.showcase_hint: An HTML with mask:url(#svgMask) shows through a luminance mask defined in inline SVG.

features.name: Mask on a group vs on each element
features.showcase_hint: A group of overlapping shapes masked once fades as a single composite, while per-element masks show overlap seams and bbox-relative differences.

features.name: SMIL animation inside mask content
features.showcase_hint: A white circle in the mask animates its radius, so the target pulses between hidden and revealed; a moving gradient sweeps a shine across text.

features.name: Filtered mask content (blur feathering)
features.showcase_hint: A hard white star in the mask carries filter=url(#blur), so the masked photo shows a soft-edged star instead of a crisp one.

features.name: Raster or SVG image as mask content
features.showcase_hint: A greyscale texture <image> inside the mask lets a solid colour rect appear as a grungy, half-transparent stamp.

features.name: Text as mask content
features.showcase_hint: White text in a mask shows a photo through glyphs; grey or gradient-filled letters are partially transparent, unlike a clip.

features.name: Pointer events ignore mask transparency
features.showcase_hint: A fully masked-out (invisible) region of a rect still highlights on hover and blocks clicks to shapes below it.

features.name: clip-path on a clipPath element (intersection)
features.showcase_hint: clipPath A carries clip-path=url(#B); the visible region of the target is the lens-shaped intersection of circle A and circle B, not their union.

features.name: text and textPath inside clipPath
features.showcase_hint: Large bold glyphs act as windows onto a photo or animated gradient; letters on a curved textPath also clip.

features.name: use element inside clipPath
features.support_note: all browsers; <use> must reference a shape or text directly, a referenced <g> is ignored
features.showcase_hint: A clipPath containing only <use href=#heart> clips an image to the reused heart path; a second use pointing at a <g> visibly clips nothing.

features.name: clip-path CSS basic shapes on SVG elements
features.showcase_hint: A row of images each clipped by inset(), circle(), ellipse(), polygon() and path() with no <clipPath> element anywhere in the document.

features.name: clip-path geometry-box keywords (fill-box, stroke-box, view-box)
features.support_note: Chrome 118+ only; older Chromium ignored the keywords
features.showcase_hint: Three copies of one thick-stroked path with inset(10%) fill-box, stroke-box and view-box show clips at different scales and positions.

features.name: mask-composite (add, subtract, intersect, exclude)
features.support_note: Chrome 120+, Safari 15.4+; older WebKit used -webkit-mask-composite with different keywords
features.showcase_hint: Two circular radial-gradient mask layers combined with subtract show a crescent; intersect shows only the lens overlap; exclude shows both crescents.

features.name: CSS mask shorthand and mask-image on SVG elements
features.support_note: Chrome 120+ and Safari 15.4+ unprefixed; older WebKit needs -webkit-mask
features.showcase_hint: A <rect> with mask-image: linear-gradient(black, transparent) fades out with no <mask> element in the document.

features.name: Multi-layer mask shorthand
features.showcase_hint: mask: url(#a), linear-gradient(...) stacks two layers so an image shows a shape window that also fades downward.

features.name: mask-mode (alpha, luminance, match-source)
features.support_note: Chrome 120+, Safari 15.4+; older Safari lacks mask-mode entirely
features.showcase_hint: The same colour gradient mask-image applied with mask-mode:alpha versus luminance yields clearly different fades.

features.name: mask-size
features.showcase_hint: A star mask-image tiled at mask-size:40px over a large rect produces a grid of small star windows; contain shows one large star.

features.name: clipPath element
features.showcase_hint: A photo or gradient rect cut to a hard-edged star silhouette defined by shape children of a <clipPath> referenced via clip-path=url(#id).

features.name: mask element
features.showcase_hint: A rect painted with a white-to-black mask: white areas show the content fully, black areas hide it, greys are semi-transparent.

features.name: clip-path property
features.showcase_hint: Same shape rendered twice, once with clip-path set as an attribute and once via a CSS class, both showing an identical url(#id) cutout.

features.name: clip-rule property
features.showcase_hint: A self-intersecting pentagram used as clip: nonzero fills the whole star with the image, evenodd punches a hole showing background through the centre.

features.name: mask property/attribute with url() reference
features.showcase_hint: Identical fades produced by mask=url(#m) as an attribute and mask:url(#m) in a stylesheet on two side-by-side rects.

features.name: mask-type property (luminance default vs alpha)
features.showcase_hint: An opaque red shape in a luminance mask reveals content only dimly while white reveals fully; the same mask with alpha reveals red and black fully.

features.name: SVGClipPathElement animated attributes
features.showcase_hint: A button toggles clipPathUnits.baseVal between 1 and 2, instantly resizing the clip window from fixed to bbox-relative.

features.name: SVGClipPathElement.transform animated transform list
features.showcase_hint: Script rotates the clipPath by appending an SVGTransform to transform.baseVal, spinning the cutout window without touching the target.

features.name: SVGMaskElement animated attributes
features.showcase_hint: Script reads maskUnits.baseVal and adjusts width.baseVal.value live with a slider, visibly enlarging the mask region.

features.name: mask height region size
features.showcase_hint: A mask with height=0.5 makes the lower half of the target vanish even though the white mask rect spans the full height.

features.name: mask y region origin
features.showcase_hint: A mask with y=0.5 hides the top half of the target regardless of the white content drawn there.

features.name: clipPathUnits=userSpaceOnUse (default)
features.showcase_hint: A 100px circle clip sits at the same canvas position over three targets; the target that does not overlap it disappears entirely.

features.name: maskUnits=userSpaceOnUse
features.showcase_hint: Mask region fixed at canvas coordinates x=50 y=50 width=100: a small target is fully hidden, a large one is masked only in that square.

features.name: Reordering effects by wrapping in groups
features.showcase_hint: Same shape twice: blur+clip on one element gives crisp edges; clipping an inner element then blurring the outer <g> gives soft edges.

features.name: Clip evaluated in target user space
features.showcase_hint: A clipped group rotates via transform; the clip window rotates along with it rather than staying fixed on the canvas.

features.name: display:none and visibility on clipPath children
features.support_note: display:none excluded everywhere; visibility=hidden handling differs across browsers
features.showcase_hint: Two clip children, one with display=none: only the visible child's shape cuts the image; the hidden circle leaves no window.

features.name: Ignored clipPath children (g, image, foreignObject)
features.showcase_hint: A clipPath containing only <image> or <g> yields an empty clip: the target disappears entirely, proving those children contribute nothing.

features.name: Clip uses raw geometry, ignores fill, stroke, opacity
features.showcase_hint: Clip child has fill=none, stroke-width=40 and opacity=0.1, yet the target is clipped to the crisp unstroked outline at full opacity.

features.name: Union of multiple clipPath children
features.showcase_hint: Three overlapping circles inside one clipPath reveal a single merged blob of the underlying image with no seams where circles overlap.

features.name: Empty clipPath hides element
features.showcase_hint: A rect referencing a clipPath with no children vanishes completely while its unclipped twin next to it renders normally.

features.name: clip-path/mask referencing an external SVG file
features.support_note: Firefox supports url(file.svg#id); Chrome and Safari require same-document references
features.showcase_hint: An element using clip-path:url(shapes.svg#star) shows the star cutout in Firefox but renders unclipped in Chrome.

features.name: getBBox and getBoundingClientRect ignore clipping
features.showcase_hint: A dashed rect drawn from getBBox() of a heavily clipped element still outlines the full unclipped geometry.

features.name: clip-path referencing missing element
features.support_note: Chrome and Safari render unclipped; Firefox historically hid the element per SVG 1.1 error rule
features.showcase_hint: A rect with clip-path=url(#doesNotExist) renders fully unclipped next to a properly clipped sibling.

features.name: mask referencing missing element
features.support_note: Chrome and Safari render unmasked; older Firefox hid the element
features.showcase_hint: A rect with mask=url(#nothing) renders fully opaque beside a correctly masked sibling.

features.name: marker overflow clipping
features.showcase_hint: An arrowhead larger than its markerWidth/markerHeight is cut off by default and drawn in full when the marker has overflow=visible.

features.name: clip-path and mask on the same element
features.showcase_hint: An image clipped to a circle and masked with a vertical gradient shows a hard circular edge that fades from top to bottom.

features.name: Opacity and fill-opacity inside mask content
features.showcase_hint: Three white rects in a mask with fill-opacity 1, 0.5 and 0.2 make the masked image appear in three stepped transparency bands.

features.name: External SVG or raster file as CSS mask-image
features.support_note: all browsers; file must be same-origin or CORS-enabled
features.showcase_hint: mask-image: url(star.svg) stamps a star-shaped window onto a gradient rect, using the SVG file's alpha.

features.name: Luminance coefficients and color-interpolation on masks
features.support_note: Firefox honours color-interpolation=linearRGB on mask; Chrome and Safari compute sRGB luminance only
features.showcase_hint: A 50% grey mask yields different transparency between browsers; a swatch pair shows linearRGB versus sRGB luminance.

features.name: Pattern-filled mask content (halftone)
features.showcase_hint: A mask rect filled with a dot pattern turns an image into a halftone screen of varying transparency.

features.name: Mask content that is itself masked
features.showcase_hint: A white rect inside mask A has mask=url(#B) (a gradient), so the target shows the product of both masks as a double fade.

features.name: objectBoundingBox fails on zero-area bounding boxes
features.showcase_hint: A horizontal line clipped or masked with objectBoundingBox units vanishes because its bbox has zero height; the same line with userSpaceOnUse renders.

features.name: overflow:visible on inline svg root
features.showcase_hint: An inline SVG in an HTML page with overflow:visible draws a shape outside its box over the surrounding HTML text.

features.name: Viewport overflow clipping also clips hit-testing
features.showcase_hint: A circle spilling out of an overflow=hidden inner svg cannot be hovered outside the viewport edge; with overflow=visible it can.

features.name: pattern tiles clip content to the tile
features.support_note: Tile clipping works everywhere; overflow=visible on <pattern> is unimplemented in all browsers
features.showcase_hint: A pattern whose circle is larger than the tile shows circles chopped into square tiles rather than overlapping neighbours.

features.name: symbol instances clip to their viewport
features.showcase_hint: A <use> of a symbol whose content exceeds its viewBox is cropped; setting overflow=visible on the symbol lets it spill.

features.name: mask-border on SVG elements
features.support_note: Not applicable to SVG elements; only -webkit-mask-box-image on HTML in Chromium/WebKit
features.showcase_hint: Listed as an exclusion: a mask-border declaration on a <rect> has no visible effect in any browser.

features.name: mask-clip geometry boxes on SVG
features.support_note: Firefox full; Chrome 120+; Safari partial for fill-box/stroke-box/view-box on SVG
features.showcase_hint: mask-clip:stroke-box keeps a thick stroke inside the masked area whereas fill-box trims it.

features.name: mask-origin geometry boxes on SVG
features.support_note: Firefox full; Chrome 120+; Safari partial for fill-box/stroke-box/view-box on SVG
features.showcase_hint: mask-origin:view-box positions a non-repeating mask image relative to the viewport, so it lands off-centre on a small shape.

features.name: mask-position
features.showcase_hint: A single non-repeating mask image shifts from top-left to centre to bottom-right across three rects.

features.name: mask-repeat
features.showcase_hint: mask-repeat:no-repeat leaves one star window while repeat-x shows a row; space distributes stars evenly.

features.name: clip property with rect() on viewports (deprecated)
features.support_note: Removed in SVG 2 and CSS Masking; Chrome and Firefox ignore it on SVG, use clip-path inset()
features.showcase_hint: An inner <svg clip="rect(...)"> is not clipped, while the same viewport with clip-path: inset() is; listed as an exclusion.

features.name: CSS box keywords (content-box, padding-box, border-box, margin-box) on SVG
features.support_note: all browsers; CSS box keywords behave as fill-box on SVG elements
features.showcase_hint: inset(10%) border-box and inset(10%) fill-box produce identical clips on a rect, while stroke-box differs.

features.name: clip-path: circle() basic shape
features.showcase_hint: A square photo becomes a circular avatar using circle(40% at 50% 50%) applied straight on the <image> element.

features.name: clip-path: ellipse() basic shape
features.showcase_hint: A wide rect clipped to ellipse(45% 30% at center), leaving oval-shaped content on a contrasting background.

features.name: clip-path geometry-box: fill-box
features.showcase_hint: A thick-stroked circle with clip-path: fill-box loses the outer half of its stroke, clipped exactly to the fill bounding box.

features.name: clip-path: inset() basic shape
features.showcase_hint: An image trimmed to an inner rectangle with rounded corners via inset(10% 20% round 12px).

features.name: clip-path: none reset
features.showcase_hint: A clipped rect regains its full shape on hover via a CSS rule setting clip-path:none, overriding the presentation attribute.

features.name: clip-path: path() basic shape
features.support_note: all browsers (Chrome 88+, Firefox 71+, Safari 13.1+); px units only, no percentages
features.showcase_hint: A heart drawn with path('M...') in CSS clips an image; the optional evenodd fill-rule argument punches a hole.

features.name: clip-path: polygon() basic shape
features.showcase_hint: A hexagon or chevron cutout produced by polygon() with percentage vertices; resizing the target reshapes the polygon proportionally.

features.name: clip-path: rect() and xywh() shapes
features.showcase_hint: Two images clipped with rect(10px 90% 80% 10px) and xywh(10px 10px 80% 60% round 8px) show rectangular windows with rounded corners.

features.name: clip-path: shape() function
features.support_note: Chrome 135+, Safari 18.4+; Firefox shipped late 2025, older versions ignore
features.showcase_hint: A responsive curved cutout built with shape(from 0 0, curve to 100% 50% with 50% 0) keeps its curve when the element resizes.

features.name: clip-path geometry-box: stroke-box
features.showcase_hint: Same circle with circle(50%) stroke-box keeps its full stroke width inside the clip, compared with fill-box next to it.

features.name: clip-path geometry-box: view-box
features.showcase_hint: A small shape with circle(30%) view-box is clipped relative to the nearest viewport, so the circle is centred on the SVG not the shape.

features.name: clip-rule=evenodd
features.showcase_hint: Same pentagram clip with evenodd leaves the centre pentagon empty; concentric rings become a donut window.

features.name: mask-type=alpha
features.showcase_hint: The same opaque red shape switches to revealing content fully because only alpha counts; black shapes now reveal too.

features.name: mask-type=luminance (default)
features.showcase_hint: Explicit mask-type=luminance: a black opaque shape hides content, white shows it, 50% grey is half-transparent.

features.name: SVGMarkerElement.setOrientToAuto
features.showcase_hint: A button call switches fixed-angle arrowheads to path-following orientation live.

features.name: markerUnits
features.showcase_hint: Two identical markers on lines of stroke-width 1 and 5: one grows with the stroke, the other stays fixed.

features.name: markerWidth / markerHeight viewport size
features.showcase_hint: Same arrow content with markerWidth 3 vs 8: the marker viewport widens and content is clipped or scaled accordingly.

features.name: orient
features.showcase_hint: Arrowheads either rotate to follow the path direction or all point the same way regardless of the segment.

features.name: marker preserveAspectRatio
features.showcase_hint: Square viewBox in a 2:1 marker box: xMinYMid meet places it left, xMaxYMid places it right, slice overflows.

features.name: refX anchor point
features.showcase_hint: Arrow tip lands exactly on the line endpoint when refX equals the tip x; with refX=0 the arrow overshoots past the vertex.

features.name: refY anchor point
features.showcase_hint: Marker centred vertically on the line with refY=half height versus hanging below the line with refY=0.

features.name: marker viewBox
features.showcase_hint: Arrow authored in a 0 0 100 100 coordinate system shrinks to fit a markerWidth of 4.

features.name: markerUnits userSpaceOnUse (fixed size)
features.showcase_hint: Arrowheads stay the same pixel size on a 1px line and a 10px line.

features.name: orient fixed angle (number, deg, rad, grad)
features.support_note: all browsers; grad/rad units rarely used
features.showcase_hint: Every marker on a curvy path is rotated the same 45 degrees regardless of the local direction.

features.name: orient auto (follow path direction)
features.showcase_hint: Arrowheads on a zigzag rotate to align with each segment's tangent; around a circle they follow the curve.

features.name: orient auto-start-reverse
features.showcase_hint: One marker definition yields a double-headed arrow: start arrow points backwards, end arrow points forwards.

features.name: arrowhead technique
features.showcase_hint: A classic triangle arrowhead whose tip sits exactly at the line end via refX at the tip, hiding the stroke beneath.

features.name: closed subpath orientation at the closing vertex
features.support_note: all browsers; SVG 2 bisects last and first segment
features.showcase_hint: On a closed triangle the start marker is angled between the closing segment and the first segment, not along the first only.

features.name: swap marker via :hover or class change
features.support_note: all browsers; marker properties are discrete, no interpolation
features.showcase_hint: Hovering a line changes its arrowhead to a larger or differently coloured marker instantly.

features.name: dimension line ticks perpendicular to the line
features.showcase_hint: A measuring line ends in short perpendicular ticks that stay perpendicular when the line is rotated.

features.name: graph edges with node glyphs and arrowheads
features.showcase_hint: Edges drawn as lines automatically get node circles at their start and arrowheads at their end.

features.name: markers under vector-effect non-scaling-stroke
features.support_note: all browsers; markers still scale with the transform while the stroke does not
features.showcase_hint: Zoomed group: line stays 1px thin but its arrowheads grow with the zoom factor.

features.name: SMIL animation of refX, orient, markerWidth
features.showcase_hint: Arrowheads slide along or spin as animate targets the marker's orient or refX attribute.

features.name: markers inherit the referencing element's transform (incl. skew)
features.showcase_hint: A path under skewX(30) shows its arrowheads sheared along with the line.

features.name: mid-marker direction is the bisector of adjacent segments
features.showcase_hint: At a 90-degree corner the mid arrow points diagonally, halfway between incoming and outgoing directions.

features.name: vertex glyphs on polylines (data points)
features.showcase_hint: A chart polyline shows a circle at every data vertex from a single marker rule.

features.name: marker versus symbol/use trade-offs
features.showcase_hint: Side by side: markers auto-orient and scale with stroke but cannot be hit-tested; use elements are placed manually but are interactive.

features.name: marker element
features.showcase_hint: A glyph defined once in defs appears at vertices of a polyline, rotated to follow the line, without being drawn directly.

features.name: marker shorthand (CSS only)
features.support_note: all browsers as CSS; not valid as a presentation attribute
features.showcase_hint: style="marker:url(#dot)" puts the same dot at start, mid and end vertices with one declaration.

features.name: marker-end
features.showcase_hint: Arrowhead appears only at the last vertex of the path.

features.name: marker-mid
features.showcase_hint: Glyphs appear at every interior vertex but not at the two ends.

features.name: marker-start
features.showcase_hint: A glyph appears only at the first vertex of a polyline.

features.name: style.markerEnd / markerStart / markerMid
features.showcase_hint: el.style.markerEnd = 'url(#head)' adds an arrowhead on click and setting it to none removes it.

features.name: getBBox({markers:true})
features.support_note: Firefox honours the option; Chrome and Safari ignore getBBox options and never include markers
features.showcase_hint: A rectangle drawn from getBBox excludes the arrowheads that stick out past the line ends in Chrome and Safari.

features.name: SVGMarkerElement.markerUnits animated enumeration
features.showcase_hint: Toggling markerUnits.baseVal between 1 and 2 flips arrowheads between stroke-scaled and fixed size.

features.name: orientType / orientAngle animated properties
features.showcase_hint: Readout shows SVG_MARKER_ORIENT_AUTO versus ANGLE while an animation changes baseVal and animVal.

features.name: refX/refY/markerWidth/markerHeight as SVGAnimatedLength
features.showcase_hint: Script sets refX.baseVal.value from a slider and the arrow tip slides along the line.

features.name: SVGMarkerElement.setOrientToAngle
features.support_note: all browsers; needs an SVGAngle from createSVGAngle
features.showcase_hint: A slider rotates all markers together by passing an SVGAngle.

features.name: SVGFitToViewBox on marker (viewBox, preserveAspectRatio)
features.showcase_hint: Changing viewBox.baseVal.width by script zooms the marker content inside its box.

features.name: markerHeight
features.showcase_hint: Tall vs short marker viewport; content beyond markerHeight is clipped when overflow is hidden.

features.name: marker position attribute (draft)
features.support_note: SVG 2 draft attribute removed with marker-pattern; no browser
features.showcase_hint: Would place markers at path positions; ignored by all browsers.

features.name: transform on marker element
features.support_note: marker is not a transformable element; transform attribute ignored in all browsers
features.showcase_hint: transform=rotate(90) on the marker element has no visible effect; rotation must go on a child g.

features.name: markerUnits strokeWidth (default, scales with stroke)
features.showcase_hint: Animating stroke-width from 1 to 6 makes the arrowheads grow with the line, one marker definition for all widths.

features.name: markerWidth or markerHeight zero disables marker
features.showcase_hint: Setting markerWidth=0 makes the marker vanish entirely while the line stays visible.

features.name: non-uniform stretch of marker content
features.showcase_hint: A circle drawn in the marker viewBox renders as an ellipse when the marker box aspect differs.

features.name: refX/refY keywords left|center|right, top|center|bottom
features.support_note: No browser accepts the keywords; treated as invalid (0) in Chrome, Firefox, Safari
features.showcase_hint: refX=center refY=center would centre the marker on the vertex with no numbers; browsers instead anchor at 0,0.

features.name: context-stroke referencing a gradient/pattern
features.support_note: Firefox resolves the gradient in the context element's space; Chrome/Safari fall back to solid or ignore
features.showcase_hint: A line stroked with a gradient gets arrowheads that continue the gradient colour at their position.

features.name: animated content inside a marker
features.support_note: all browsers; CSS animations inside markers also work
features.showcase_hint: Every vertex dot pulses in sync because a single animate element lives in the marker.

features.name: markers vanish with base href or routed URLs
features.support_note: all browsers; url(#id) resolves against document base
features.showcase_hint: Adding a base element makes markers disappear until url() uses the full page URL plus fragment.

features.name: gradients, patterns and filters inside marker content
features.support_note: all browsers; objectBoundingBox units resolve per marker content
features.showcase_hint: Each arrowhead carries its own gradient fill and blur filter rendered in marker space.

features.name: currentColor inside marker content follows the marker's own color
features.support_note: all browsers; color is not taken from the host shape
features.showcase_hint: Arrowheads filled with currentColor take the colour set on the marker or defs, not the referencing line.

features.name: orientation on curves uses the tangent
features.showcase_hint: Arrowhead at the end of a Bezier curve aligns with the curve's final tangent, not the chord.

features.name: markers on dashed strokes ignore dash gaps
features.showcase_hint: Vertex dots appear at every vertex even where the dash pattern leaves a gap.

features.name: marker element is never rendered directly
features.support_note: all browsers render markers only via marker properties
features.showcase_hint: A marker placed outside defs stays invisible unless referenced by a shape.

features.name: opacity, filter, clip-path, mask on host apply to markers
features.showcase_hint: A drop-shadow filter on the line also shadows its arrowheads; opacity 0.3 fades markers with the stroke.

features.name: marker referenced from an external SVG file
features.support_note: Firefox supports url(file.svg#id); Chrome and Safari render no marker
features.showcase_hint: marker-end=url(arrows.svg#head) shows an arrowhead in Firefox and nothing in Chrome.

features.name: markers track an animated path d or points
features.showcase_hint: As the path morphs, arrowheads move with the endpoints and re-orient every frame.

features.name: display none on marker or its ancestors does not disable it
features.showcase_hint: Markers defined inside a display:none group still appear on referencing lines.

features.name: markers are not hit-testable
features.support_note: all browsers; pointer-events inside marker content ignored
features.showcase_hint: Clicking or hovering an arrowhead does nothing while hovering the line itself triggers a highlight.

features.name: marker properties inherit to descendant shapes
features.showcase_hint: marker-end set on a g gives every line inside the group an arrowhead without per-element attributes.

features.name: reversed start arrow without auto-start-reverse
features.showcase_hint: Two marker definitions, one mirrored via rotate(180) around refX/refY, form a double-headed arrow.

features.name: marker defined in one inline svg used by another
features.support_note: all browsers within the same HTML document
features.showcase_hint: A hidden sprite svg holds the marker; several separate inline svgs show the same arrowhead.

features.name: marker content inherits from the marker's ancestors, not the host shape
features.showcase_hint: A blue line gets black arrowheads because the marker content does not inherit the line's stroke colour.

features.name: start/end only at path ends, mid at subpath starts
features.showcase_hint: A path with two M subpaths shows one start and one end marker; the second subpath's first vertex gets a mid marker.

features.name: text inside marker content
features.support_note: all browsers; text rotates with orient auto
features.showcase_hint: A tiny label glyph appears at every vertex, tilted along the path direction when orient is auto.

features.name: markers render even when stroke is none
features.showcase_hint: A path with stroke=none but stroke-width=4 shows only its markers, sized by the invisible stroke width.

features.name: direction with zero-length segments or coincident control points
features.support_note: Browsers differ on degenerate curves; Firefox and Chrome disagree on orientation
features.showcase_hint: A path whose last segment has zero length still orients its end arrow using the previous segment's direction.

features.name: SVG 2 markers on rect, circle, ellipse
features.support_note: Chrome, Firefox and Safari draw markers only on path, line, polyline, polygon
features.showcase_hint: marker-mid on a rect should place glyphs at its four corners; browsers show nothing, so use an equivalent path.

features.name: marker content that itself uses markers
features.support_note: Self-reference is an error everywhere; one-level nesting works in Firefox, Chrome and Safari but depth limits differ
features.showcase_hint: An arrowhead marker whose inner path has its own tiny dot markers at its vertices.

features.name: marker properties from external/embedded CSS
features.support_note: all browsers; url() must resolve against document base
features.showcase_hint: A class rule .arrow{marker-end:url(#head)} adds arrowheads to every matching path without attributes.

features.name: marker-knockout-left / marker-knockout-right
features.showcase_hint: Would erase the stroke beneath a marker so hollow arrowheads show no line inside; browsers ignore it.

features.name: marker-pattern (repeating markers along path)
features.support_note: Proposed in SVG 2 drafts then removed; no browser
features.showcase_hint: Would repeat ticks every N units along the path; nothing renders, emulate with stroke-dasharray.

features.name: marker-segment (per-segment midpoint marker)
features.showcase_hint: Would put a marker at the midpoint of every segment; browsers ignore it.

features.name: marker none reset
features.showcase_hint: A child path inside a group whose CSS sets marker-mid removes its vertex dots via marker-mid:none.

features.name: stroke context-fill
features.showcase_hint: Marker outlines take the host polygon's fill colour while the marker interior stays white.

features.name: stdDeviation blur radius
features.showcase_hint: Row of shapes with stdDeviation 1, 4, 12 getting progressively softer.

features.name: filterUnits
features.showcase_hint: Same filter on a small and a large rect: objectBoundingBox halo scales with each; userSpaceOnUse box stays fixed.

features.name: primitiveUnits
features.support_note: all browsers; Safari historically mis-scaled some primitive lengths in objectBoundingBox
features.showcase_hint: stdDeviation=0.05 with primitiveUnits=objectBoundingBox blurs a large rect far more than a small one; default keeps a fixed pixel radius.

features.name: filter region x/y/width/height
features.showcase_hint: A blurred circle with region x=-50% width=200% shows a full soft halo; the default-region copy is clipped to a square edge.

features.name: feColorMatrix luminanceToAlpha
features.showcase_hint: Bright regions become opaque black, dark regions transparent; used as an auto-generated mask.

features.name: feComposite arithmetic with k1..k4
features.showcase_hint: k2=0.5 k3=0.5 cross-fades two inputs; k4 adds a constant giving a lifted, tinted look.

features.name: SourceAlpha keyword
features.showcase_hint: A multicolor element becomes a solid black silhouette when SourceAlpha is used as the final input.

features.name: Anisotropic blur with two stdDeviation values
features.showcase_hint: stdDeviation='10 0' produces a horizontal motion streak while vertical edges stay sharp.

features.name: feImage href to an in-document element (#id)
features.support_note: Chrome and Safari render element references; Firefox does not (bug 455986); placement differs across engines
features.showcase_hint: A shape defined once in the document appears inside the filter as an input layer without an external file.

features.name: SourceAlpha + blur + offset + merge shadow chain
features.showcase_hint: Element over a blurred black offset silhouette; identical to feDropShadow but built from four primitives.

features.name: Duotone/false-colour by greyscale plus per-channel tables
features.showcase_hint: Photo rendered in two brand colors mapped from dark to light.

features.name: in / in2 / result wiring between primitives
features.showcase_hint: A named 'blur' result is reused by a later offset and merge, producing a shadow plus glow from one blur pass.

features.name: Filter on a group composites children first
features.showcase_hint: Overlapping circles in a filtered group cast one merged shadow; per-child filters show shadows crossing each other.

features.name: Filter effects on text
features.showcase_hint: Headline text with glow, drop shadow, or embossed outline while remaining selectable text.

features.name: Per-primitive subregion x/y/width/height
features.showcase_hint: A feFlood limited to x=20% width=60% draws a colored band only through the middle of the element.

features.name: Inner shadow via SourceAlpha out compositing
features.showcase_hint: Shape looks recessed with a shadow along its inside edge, built from feComposite out + blur + in.

features.name: Outline/halo via blurred alpha thresholded then flooded
features.showcase_hint: Text gets a uniform colored outline that follows glyph shapes without stroke.

features.name: Text label background box via feFlood+feMerge
features.showcase_hint: Text sits on a padded colored box sized automatically to the text, no rect element.

features.name: Chaining several filters: filter: url(#a) url(#b) blur(2px)
features.support_note: all browsers; Safari historically dropped lists mixing url() with functions
features.showcase_hint: Element shows a recolor from one filter plus a shadow from another; swapping the order changes the result.

features.name: CSS filter functions (blur, drop-shadow, grayscale, hue-rotate...) on SVG elements
features.showcase_hint: SVG circle with style filter:blur(3px) drop-shadow(...) looks blurred and shadowed with no filter element in the document.

features.name: SVG filter applied to HTML elements and the outermost svg via filter:url(#id)
features.showcase_hint: An HTML div or img gets an SVG feColorMatrix duotone from a filter defined in an inline svg.

features.name: feBlend
features.support_note: all browsers; all 16 CSS blend modes supported
features.showcase_hint: Overlapping colored gradients combine into new colors where they intersect; a sheet shows all modes side by side.

features.name: feColorMatrix
features.showcase_hint: Colored image or gradient re-mapped to different hues or greys; sheet shows matrix, saturate, hueRotate side by side.

features.name: feComponentTransfer per-channel remap
features.showcase_hint: Gradient bar shows posterized, inverted, or contrast-stretched bands compared to the original.

features.name: feComposite Porter-Duff compositing
features.showcase_hint: Two overlapping shapes combined so only part of one remains visible; a sheet shows over/in/out/atop/xor together.

features.name: feDropShadow single-primitive shadow
features.showcase_hint: Element with a soft colored shadow from one primitive using flood-color; compare with the 4-primitive classic chain.

features.name: feFlood solid color fill
features.showcase_hint: A colored rectangle covering the whole filter region appears behind the element after feComposite or feMerge.

features.name: feFuncA alpha channel function
features.showcase_hint: Blurred alpha thresholded via feFuncA discrete: soft glow becomes a hard outline (dilate effect).

features.name: feFuncB blue channel function
features.showcase_hint: Only blue channel clamped to zero: image gets a warm yellow cast.

features.name: feFuncG green channel function
features.showcase_hint: Only green channel boosted with a gamma curve: neutrals shift toward green.

features.name: feFuncR red channel function
features.showcase_hint: Only red channel inverted: white becomes cyan, red becomes black.

features.name: feGaussianBlur
features.showcase_hint: Crisp shape becomes soft-edged with a glow fading outward.

features.name: feImage external/data-URI image input
features.support_note: all browsers for external images; cross-origin images need CORS
features.showcase_hint: A raster texture appears composited inside the element's silhouette via feComposite in.

features.name: feMerge stacking
features.showcase_hint: Several intermediate results stacked; the original remains visible on top of blur and offset layers.

features.name: feMergeNode layer order
features.showcase_hint: Swapping node order puts the shadow above the element, hiding it; the last node draws on top.

features.name: feOffset translation
features.showcase_hint: A copy of the element shifted by dx/dy appears beside or behind the original.

features.name: feTile repeating an input subregion
features.support_note: all browsers; Chrome has subregion offset quirks
features.showcase_hint: A small feImage or feFlood square repeated as a checker pattern across the whole element.

features.name: filter element
features.showcase_hint: A shape referenced via filter=url(#id) renders with a visible blur or shadow that its un-filtered twin lacks.

features.name: color-interpolation-filters (linearRGB default vs sRGB)
features.support_note: all browsers; Safari inconsistent for a few primitives
features.showcase_hint: Two blurred red/green boundaries: linearRGB gives a bright yellowish mid, sRGB gives a darker muddy mid.

features.name: filter presentation property (attribute or CSS url())
features.showcase_hint: Same shape twice: one with filter attribute, one with CSS filter:url(#id); both show the identical effect.

features.name: flood-color (feFlood and feDropShadow)
features.showcase_hint: Flood color changed via a CSS rule or hover produces a different background tint or shadow color under the element.

features.name: flood-opacity
features.showcase_hint: Semi-transparent flood lets the underlying element or page show through the tinted region.

features.name: CSS.supports('filter','url(#x)') feature detection
features.showcase_hint: Page prints detected support flags for filter functions and url() references next to the filtered sample.

features.name: feFunc* type/tableValues/slope/intercept/amplitude/exponent/offset DOM access
features.showcase_hint: Slider changes exponent.baseVal and gamma curve brightness updates live.

features.name: SVGFEBlendElement.mode with SVG_FEBLEND_MODE_* constants
features.support_note: all browsers; constants only cover 1.1 modes, newer modes report UNKNOWN
features.showcase_hint: Dropdown switches blend mode via setAttribute and readback displays the constant value.

features.name: SVGFEColorMatrixElement.values SVGAnimatedNumberList
features.showcase_hint: Script edits matrix numbers each frame producing an animated hue cycle.

features.name: SVGFECompositeElement k1..k4 animated numbers
features.showcase_hint: Cross-fade slider adjusts k2/k3 via baseVal; the image blends live.

features.name: SVGFEDropShadowElement.setStdDeviation
features.showcase_hint: Shadow softness updates as script calls the method.

features.name: SVGFEGaussianBlurElement.setStdDeviation(x, y)
features.showcase_hint: Slider drives blur radius in real time via the DOM method.

features.name: SVGFilterElement animated attribute access (filterUnits, x, width...)
features.showcase_hint: Script toggles filterUnits.baseVal and enlarges width.baseVal; the halo stops being clipped live.

features.name: Primitive x/y/width/height/result animated attributes
features.showcase_hint: Script rewires result names causing a different intermediate layer to be displayed.

features.name: in2 second input (feBlend, feComposite, feDisplacementMap)
features.showcase_hint: feBlend with in2=flood shows the element tinted by a color that comes only from the second input.

features.name: feBlend mode
features.showcase_hint: Same two inputs blended with multiply versus screen: overlap darkens in one, brightens in the other.

features.name: feColorMatrix type
features.showcase_hint: Same values attribute interpreted differently as type switches between matrix, saturate and hueRotate.

features.name: feColorMatrix values
features.showcase_hint: Channel-swap matrix turning red into blue; a single number for saturate or hueRotate.

features.name: feComposite k1/k2/k3/k4
features.showcase_hint: Changing k4 raises overall brightness uniformly; k1 multiplies the two inputs.

features.name: feComposite operator
features.showcase_hint: Switching operator on the same two inputs changes which overlap region survives.

features.name: feDropShadow dx/dy/stdDeviation
features.showcase_hint: Shadow direction and softness vary across a row of copies.

features.name: amplitude
features.showcase_hint: Gamma curve scaled so white maps to half intensity.

features.name: exponent
features.showcase_hint: Gamma 2.2 darkening midtones.

features.name: intercept
features.showcase_hint: Channel floor lifted so black becomes dark grey.

features.name: offset (gamma transfer)
features.showcase_hint: Gamma curve shifted upward.

features.name: slope
features.showcase_hint: Alpha halved with slope 0.5.

features.name: tableValues
features.showcase_hint: Alpha ramp inverted with tableValues 1 0.

features.name: transfer function type (all feFunc*)
features.showcase_hint: Same gradient rendered through identity, table, discrete, linear and gamma in a row.

features.name: edgeMode on feGaussianBlur (none/duplicate/wrap)
features.support_note: No shipping Chrome, Firefox or Safari applies edgeMode on feGaussianBlur; all behave as none
features.showcase_hint: With duplicate, a blurred rect filling its subregion would keep solid edges; browsers still fade to transparent.

features.name: feImage crossorigin
features.support_note: Chrome supports; Firefox and Safari support inconsistent
features.showcase_hint: Cross-origin image loads with a CORS header and appears; without it the filter output is blank or tainted.

features.name: feImage href (SVG 2 unprefixed)
features.showcase_hint: Same image loads with plain href; the xlink:href twin shows identical output.

features.name: feImage preserveAspectRatio
features.support_note: all browsers for external images; ignored for element references
features.showcase_hint: none stretches the image to fill the subregion; xMidYMid slice crops it centered.

features.name: feImage x/y/width/height placement
features.showcase_hint: Image tile positioned at a corner of the filter region rather than filling it.

features.name: feImage xlink:href
features.support_note: Still works everywhere but deprecated by SVG 2 in favor of href
features.showcase_hint: Legacy syntax renders identically to href.

features.name: feMergeNode in
features.showcase_hint: Each node names a result or keyword; a node with in=SourceGraphic restores the crisp original.

features.name: feOffset dx/dy (including negative and fractional)
features.showcase_hint: Shadows offset up-left with negative values versus down-right with positive.

features.name: filterRes intermediate resolution
features.support_note: Removed in Filter Effects 1; Chrome dropped it, Firefox and Safari never honored it
features.showcase_hint: A filter with filterRes=4 renders at full resolution rather than pixelated; identical to omitting it.

features.name: filter href inheritance from another filter
features.support_note: Dropped in Filter Effects 1; no browser implements inheritance
features.showcase_hint: A filter with only href and no primitives renders the element unfiltered or empty in all browsers.

features.name: feBlend color
features.showcase_hint: Photo-like backdrop tinted with source hue and saturation while keeping luminosity (colorize).

features.name: feBlend color-burn
features.showcase_hint: Backdrop darkened toward black where the source is dark.

features.name: feBlend color-dodge
features.showcase_hint: Backdrop brightened toward white where the source is bright.

features.name: feBlend darken
features.showcase_hint: Per-channel minimum: overlap keeps the darker channels of each input.

features.name: feBlend difference
features.showcase_hint: Identical colors cancel to black; white over a color inverts it.

features.name: feBlend exclusion
features.showcase_hint: Lower-contrast inversion than difference; mid greys stay grey.

features.name: feBlend hard-light
features.showcase_hint: Multiply or screen depending on source lightness; harsh spotlight look.

features.name: feBlend hue
features.showcase_hint: Backdrop keeps its brightness and saturation but adopts the source hue.

features.name: feBlend lighten
features.showcase_hint: Per-channel maximum: overlap keeps the lighter channels.

features.name: feBlend luminosity
features.showcase_hint: Source brightness applied to backdrop colors; the inverse of color mode.

features.name: feBlend multiply
features.showcase_hint: Overlap darker than either input; yellow over cyan gives green.

features.name: feBlend normal
features.showcase_hint: in simply covers in2 like source-over.

features.name: feBlend overlay
features.showcase_hint: Contrast boost: mid-grey backdrop shows strong tinting, dark and light backdrops less.

features.name: feBlend saturation
features.showcase_hint: Grey source desaturates the backdrop where they overlap.

features.name: feBlend screen
features.showcase_hint: Overlap lighter than either input; red over green gives yellow.

features.name: feBlend soft-light
features.showcase_hint: Gentle version of hard-light; subtle darkening and lightening.

features.name: feColorMatrix hueRotate
features.showcase_hint: Rainbow gradient shifted around the hue wheel by 90 or 180 degrees.

features.name: feColorMatrix matrix (4x5 values)
features.showcase_hint: Channel-swap matrix turns red areas blue; a sepia matrix warms a photo.

features.name: feColorMatrix saturate
features.showcase_hint: values 0 gives greyscale, 1 unchanged, 3 oversaturated garish colors.

features.name: feComposite atop
features.showcase_hint: Texture appears only where the backdrop shape exists, and the backdrop shows elsewhere within it.

features.name: feComposite in
features.showcase_hint: Flood clipped to the element's alpha: solid recolor of the silhouette.

features.name: feComposite lighter (additive)
features.support_note: Chrome and Firefox support; WebKit/Safari does not implement lighter
features.showcase_hint: Overlapping semi-transparent colors sum toward white where they meet; Safari falls back to over.

features.name: feComposite out
features.showcase_hint: Element punched out of a flood leaving a hole shaped like it (knockout).

features.name: feComposite over (default)
features.showcase_hint: in drawn on top of in2; standard stacking.

features.name: feComposite xor
features.showcase_hint: Two overlapping discs render with a transparent lens where they intersect.

features.name: transfer type discrete (posterize)
features.showcase_hint: Smooth gradient becomes 4 flat bands; used for posterize and hard threshold.

features.name: transfer type gamma with amplitude/exponent/offset
features.showcase_hint: exponent 0.5 brightens midtones, exponent 2.2 darkens them, endpoints unchanged.

features.name: transfer type identity
features.showcase_hint: Channel passes unchanged; visibly identical to source while other channels are altered.

features.name: transfer type linear with slope/intercept
features.showcase_hint: slope 2 intercept -0.5 stretches contrast; slope 0.5 intercept 0.25 flattens it.

features.name: transfer type table with tableValues
features.showcase_hint: tableValues='1 0' inverts a channel smoothly; '0 1 0' makes mid-tones brightest.

features.name: BackgroundAlpha keyword
features.support_note: Removed in Filter Effects 1; no browser support
features.showcase_hint: Would give a silhouette of the backdrop; renders empty today.

features.name: BackgroundImage keyword
features.support_note: Removed in Filter Effects 1; only old IE/Opera implemented; use CSS backdrop-filter
features.showcase_hint: Intended to blur what is behind the element; browsers yield transparent black, feBlend against it shows only the source.

features.name: FillPaint keyword
features.support_note: Removed in Filter Effects 1; browsers treat as transparent black
features.showcase_hint: Intended to yield an infinite plane of the element's fill paint; browsers render nothing.

features.name: SourceGraphic keyword
features.showcase_hint: feMerge places the crisp original colored element on top of a shadow via in=SourceGraphic.

features.name: StrokePaint keyword
features.support_note: Removed in Filter Effects 1; browsers treat as transparent black
features.showcase_hint: Intended to yield the stroke paint as a full-region fill; renders empty.

features.name: stdDeviation 0 pass-through
features.showcase_hint: Element renders unblurred yet still clipped to the filter region, proving the filter is active.

features.name: filterUnits objectBoundingBox (default)
features.showcase_hint: Region percentages resolve against each element's bbox; halos proportionally sized on differently sized shapes.

features.name: filterUnits userSpaceOnUse
features.showcase_hint: Filter region drawn as an absolute user-space box; effects visible only inside that fixed box regardless of element size.

features.name: primitiveUnits objectBoundingBox
features.support_note: all browsers; Safari historically mis-scaled some primitive values
features.showcase_hint: dx=0.1 shifts the shadow by 10% of the bounding box: the large rect gets a large shadow.

features.name: primitiveUnits userSpaceOnUse (default)
features.showcase_hint: stdDeviation=4 blurs small and large elements by an identical absolute pixel radius.

features.name: Arithmetic compositing to boost or threshold alpha
features.showcase_hint: Blurred silhouette hardened into a crisp expanded outline via feComposite arithmetic with a large k2.

features.name: feTile requires an explicit input subregion
features.showcase_hint: Without x/y/width/height on the input, feTile shows a single un-tiled image; with them the tiling appears.

features.name: Filter is applied in user space before the element's transform
features.showcase_hint: Rotated rect with dx-only shadow: the shadow direction rotates with the element rather than staying screen-right.

features.name: Order: filter, then clip-path, then mask, then opacity
features.showcase_hint: Blurred element clipped by a circle has a hard circular edge; the glow does not leak past the clip.

features.name: Filter on empty or invisible group renders nothing in objectBoundingBox mode
features.showcase_hint: feFlood filter on an empty g shows nothing, but a filled box when the region is userSpaceOnUse.

features.name: objectBoundingBox filter vanishes on zero-width/height bbox
features.showcase_hint: Horizontal line with a blur filter disappears; twin with filterUnits=userSpaceOnUse renders blurred.

features.name: Filter region clipping of shadows and blur
features.showcase_hint: Drop shadow with large dx is chopped flat on one side until the filter region is enlarged in the fixed twin.

features.name: filter x/y/width/height accept percentages and user units
features.support_note: all browsers accept percentages and user units; other CSS units inconsistent
features.showcase_hint: width=200% and width=300 (user units) give the same enlarged shadow region on a 150-wide rect.

features.name: Default filter region -10%/-10%/120%/120%
features.showcase_hint: Large blur on a rect is hard-cut 10% outside its bbox; a dashed outline drawn at the default region matches the cut.

features.name: feFlood fills the entire filter region
features.showcase_hint: Colored rectangle extends 10% beyond the element's bounds, exposing the default region.

features.name: Implicit chaining when in is omitted
features.showcase_hint: Blur then offset with no in attributes: shadow is blurred and shifted; first primitive defaults to SourceGraphic.

features.name: Filter output is the last primitive
features.showcase_hint: Ending a filter with feFlood shows a solid colored box instead of the element; reordering restores it.

features.name: Fan-out: one result feeding several primitives
features.showcase_hint: Two primitives both taking in=blur produce independent outer glow and inner shadow from one blur in one filter.

features.name: Filtered element inside a filtered group
features.showcase_hint: Inner element blurred, then the whole group gets a drop shadow of the blurred result.

features.name: Colour primitives operate on un-premultiplied values; alpha row affects edges
features.showcase_hint: Matrix with alpha row 0 0 0 1 0 keeps antialiased edges while colour rows recolor; an alpha-scaling row fades the whole shape.

features.name: Default primitive subregion: union of inputs vs full filter region
features.support_note: Engines differ: Chrome uses union of input subregions; Filter Effects 1 says full filter region
features.showcase_hint: feFlood after a subregion-restricted primitive fills either the whole region or only the union, visibly different across engines.

features.name: One filter definition shared by many elements
features.showcase_hint: Several differently sized and colored shapes all show the same shadow style from one filter id.

features.name: Using a primitive subregion as a crop
features.showcase_hint: Image cropped to a rectangle purely by an feOffset with x/y/width/height, no clip-path used.

features.name: CSS custom properties driving flood-color or filter
features.showcase_hint: Changing --shadow on the root recolors all shadows on the page.

features.name: CSS transitions/animations of filter functions
features.support_note: all browsers; url() filters do not interpolate, they switch
features.showcase_hint: On hover the blur smoothly animates from 0 to 6px; a url()-based filter snaps instead.

features.name: filter: url(external.svg#id)
features.support_note: Chrome and Firefox resolve external filter files; Safari does not
features.showcase_hint: Element filtered by a filter defined in a separate .svg file; renders unfiltered in Safari.

features.name: CSS transition of flood-color/flood-opacity
features.showcase_hint: Shadow color fades smoothly between two colors on hover via CSS on feDropShadow or feFlood.

features.name: color-interpolation-filters: linearRGB (default)
features.showcase_hint: feFlood #808080 composited at half opacity over white looks lighter than the sRGB twin.

features.name: color-interpolation-filters: sRGB
features.showcase_hint: feColorMatrix saturate in sRGB matches CSS filter() output, versus the lighter linearRGB default result.

features.name: filter: none override
features.showcase_hint: Child inside a group targeted by a CSS filter rule uses filter:none and renders crisp while siblings stay blurred.

features.name: flood-color: currentColor
features.showcase_hint: Two uses of one filter show differently colored shadows driven by each element's CSS color.

features.name: edgeMode border handling
features.support_note: all browsers; wrap edge colours differ slightly per engine
features.showcase_hint: Three tiles of the same blurred image: smeared border (duplicate), opposite edge bleeding in (wrap), dark fringe (none).

features.name: kernelMatrix weights
features.showcase_hint: Several tiles, each with a different kernel: identity, sharpen, emboss, Sobel edges, Gaussian-like blur, all from one source image.

features.name: Kernel order (size), incl. non-square
features.support_note: all browsers; very large orders are slow
features.showcase_hint: Same image filtered with 3x3 vs 5x5 vs 7x1 kernel showing wider blur or horizontal motion-blur streaks.

features.name: surfaceScale height
features.showcase_hint: Increasing surfaceScale makes the same bump map look deeper with stronger shadows; negative inverts bumps to dents.

features.name: in2 map source
features.showcase_hint: Same text distorted by turbulence noise, then by a linear gradient (smooth lens bend), then by a feImage bitmap.

features.name: scale magnitude
features.showcase_hint: Scale 0 leaves text intact; 10 ripples it; 60 shreds it into fragments; negative flips displacement direction.

features.name: xChannelSelector R/G/B/A
features.showcase_hint: Switching from R to G with the same noise map gives a different horizontal wobble pattern on the same grid.

features.name: azimuth angle
features.showcase_hint: Tiles at azimuth 0, 90, 180, 270 show shading rotating around the same embossed shape.

features.name: operator erode / dilate
features.showcase_hint: Same bold text side by side: erode turns it hairline, dilate turns it chunky with gaps between letters closing.

features.name: radius with two values (anisotropic)
features.showcase_hint: radius="8 0" stretches shapes horizontally only, while "0 8" stretches vertically; square becomes a wide or tall rectangle.

features.name: Point light z height
features.support_note: all browsers; primitiveUnits=objectBoundingBox scaling of z is inconsistent
features.showcase_hint: Moving z from 20 to 200 changes hotspot from tight and intense to broad and even.

features.name: specularExponent shininess
features.showcase_hint: Exponent 1 gives broad dull sheen; 20 gives tight, sharp mirror-like highlights.

features.name: limitingConeAngle hard cutoff
features.support_note: all browsers; edge is slightly antialiased per spec
features.showcase_hint: A crisp circular boundary where light stops abruptly, versus gradual falloff when the attribute is omitted.

features.name: pointsAtX/Y/Z aim target
features.showcase_hint: Changing the aim point slides the lit ellipse across the surface while the light origin stays fixed.

features.name: baseFrequency (one or two values)
features.showcase_hint: Low value gives large blobs, high value fine grain; "0.01 0.2" yields horizontally stretched streaks like wood grain.

features.name: numOctaves detail layers
features.support_note: all browsers; high values cost render time
features.showcase_hint: Row of tiles from 1 to 6 octaves: blurry blobs progressively gain fine crinkly detail.

features.name: stitchTiles seamless tiling
features.showcase_hint: Noise tiled in a pattern shows visible seams with noStitch and seamless continuation with stitch.

features.name: type turbulence vs fractalNoise
features.showcase_hint: Two tiles with identical frequency: veined, creased marble-like turbulence beside soft smooth fractalNoise clouds.

features.name: Animated light position / angle
features.support_note: all browsers; SMIL animate on fePointLight/feDistantLight/feSpotLight attributes
features.showcase_hint: Highlight and shadow sweep across an embossed logo as the light orbits it continuously.

features.name: Animated noise (baseFrequency/seed)
features.support_note: all browsers; seed animation jumps discretely, baseFrequency morphs continuously
features.showcase_hint: Clouds slowly morph and flow as baseFrequency animates; animating seed instead makes the texture flicker between patterns.

features.name: Brushed metal texture
features.showcase_hint: Fine horizontal streaks from anisotropic baseFrequency plus lighting, giving a brushed aluminium surface.

features.name: Chrome / polished metal text
features.showcase_hint: Letters with mirror-like gradient bands, bevelled edges and sharp specular highlights resembling chrome.

features.name: Edge detection (Laplacian / Sobel)
features.showcase_hint: Image reduced to bright outlines on black, like a line drawing of the object edges.

features.name: Emboss recipe
features.showcase_hint: Text or logo looks stamped into grey metal with light top-left and dark bottom-right relief edges.

features.name: Sharpen / unsharp kernel
features.showcase_hint: Slightly soft photo becomes crisp with accentuated edges; side-by-side with original shows halo at high contrast edges.

features.name: Filter rasterised at device pixels
features.support_note: all browsers; kernel-based primitives depend on DPR and zoom
features.showcase_hint: Convolution or morphology radius appears relatively smaller when the element is scaled up, unlike geometry.

features.name: Glass / frosted refraction recipe
features.showcase_hint: Content behind a pane looks refracted and slightly blurred, with specular sheen, as if seen through textured glass.

features.name: Halftone dot screen
features.support_note: all browsers; feImage element references limited in Chrome/Safari, use data-URI pattern
features.showcase_hint: A gradient or photo reproduced as a grid of dots whose size varies with brightness, like newspaper print.

features.name: Heat shimmer / mirage
features.showcase_hint: Vertical wavering of a scene above a road, animated by drifting fractal noise driving small displacement.

features.name: Alpha channel as height map
features.showcase_hint: Blurred SourceAlpha yields rounded beveled edges; unblurred alpha yields a flat plateau with a thin lit rim only.

features.name: Liquid / gooey distortion
features.showcase_hint: Text or blobs wobble like they are underwater, edges undulating continuously via animated turbulence plus displacement.

features.name: Outline via dilate minus source
features.showcase_hint: Coloured outline hugging text or an image silhouette, produced by dilating alpha, flooding a colour, and compositing out the original.

features.name: Neon glow via dilate + blur
features.showcase_hint: Thin strokes wrapped in a bright halo with a thicker inner tube colour, glowing on a dark background.

features.name: Paper grain / film grain overlay
features.showcase_hint: A plain colour fill gains subtle speckled grain, visible on zoom, like recycled paper or analogue film.

features.name: Watercolor bleed edges
features.showcase_hint: Crisp shapes get ragged, feathered edges with darker pooled rims, like pigment bleeding on wet paper.

features.name: feConvolveMatrix primitive
features.support_note: all browsers; edge-pixel and bias handling differ slightly between engines
features.showcase_hint: A photo whose pixels are recomputed from neighbours: sharpened, embossed or edge-detected version beside the untouched original.

features.name: feDiffuseLighting primitive
features.showcase_hint: Flat text or shape becomes a matte 3-D relief with shaded sides, lit from a chosen direction.

features.name: feDisplacementMap primitive
features.support_note: all browsers; Safari has DPR scaling bugs in some versions
features.showcase_hint: Straight grid lines or text are warped into wobbly distortions driven by a second image.

features.name: feDistantLight source
features.showcase_hint: Relief lit uniformly across the whole surface, like sunlight, with all bumps shaded identically.

features.name: feMorphology primitive
features.support_note: all browsers; large radii are slow
features.showcase_hint: Text rendered thin, normal and fat from the same glyphs; strokes shrink or grow uniformly.

features.name: fePointLight source
features.showcase_hint: A bright hotspot at the light position falling off radially across the textured surface.

features.name: feSpecularLighting primitive
features.showcase_hint: Bright glossy highlights on a bump map, rendered alone as white speckles on transparent background.

features.name: feSpotLight source
features.showcase_hint: A cone of light illuminating part of the surface with darkness outside the cone.

features.name: feTurbulence primitive
features.support_note: all browsers; Perlin implementation identical, device-scale caveats differ
features.showcase_hint: A rectangle filled with coloured Perlin noise clouds instead of a solid fill.

features.name: lighting-color property
features.support_note: all browsers; also settable via CSS
features.showcase_hint: Same relief lit with white, orange and cyan lights; setting the value via a CSS class changes the light tint.

features.name: Scripted kernelMatrix (SVGAnimatedNumberList)
features.showcase_hint: An editable 3x3 grid of numbers updates the convolved image live as values change.

features.name: Scripted displacement scale
features.showcase_hint: Dragging a slider changes distortion strength live via scale.baseVal.

features.name: Scripted distant light angle
features.showcase_hint: A dial control rotates shading direction on a relief by setting azimuth.baseVal.

features.name: Scripted morphology radius
features.showcase_hint: Mouse position drives stroke weight of text through radiusX/radiusY baseVal.

features.name: Scripted point light position
features.showcase_hint: The hotspot on an embossed surface tracks the pointer as x/y baseVal are updated per mousemove.

features.name: Scripted spotlight aim
features.showcase_hint: The spotlight follows the cursor across a bump-mapped surface via pointsAtX/pointsAtY updates.

features.name: Scripted baseFrequency animation
features.showcase_hint: Noise texture morphs in sync with a slider or requestAnimationFrame loop driven by JavaScript.

features.name: Scripted seed re-roll
features.showcase_hint: A Regenerate button assigns a random seed and the texture instantly changes pattern.

features.name: bias offset
features.support_note: Chrome/Safari multiply bias by alpha (premultiplied); Firefox differs; results not interoperable
features.showcase_hint: Emboss kernel with bias 0.5 turns a dark relief into mid-grey relief; transparent regions may become grey in some browsers.

features.name: divisor normalisation
features.support_note: all browsers; divisor 0 falls back to kernel sum
features.showcase_hint: Blur kernel with divisor 9 looks normal; divisor 3 blows out to near white; divisor omitted auto-normalises.

features.name: kernelUnitLength (convolution)
features.support_note: no shipping browser implements; kernel always samples device pixels
features.showcase_hint: Would make kernel size zoom-independent; in browsers the attribute has no visible effect (exclusion demo).

features.name: preserveAlpha true/false
features.showcase_hint: Edge-detect kernel on a shape with transparent surround: false makes edges glow into transparency, true keeps original silhouette.

features.name: targetX kernel anchor
features.showcase_hint: Identity kernel with targetX shifted produces a visible horizontal offset of the image relative to its frame.

features.name: targetY kernel anchor
features.showcase_hint: Identity kernel with targetY changed shifts the image vertically; combined with edgeMode shows how edges refill.

features.name: diffuseConstant
features.showcase_hint: Kd 0.5 renders dim grey relief; 1 normal; 2 blown-out bright highlights on the lit faces.

features.name: kernelUnitLength (lighting)
features.support_note: no shipping browser implements for feDiffuseLighting or feSpecularLighting
features.showcase_hint: Would fix surface-normal sampling to user units; visible effect absent in all browsers (exclusion demo).

features.name: yChannelSelector R/G/B/A
features.showcase_hint: Using the same channel for x and y makes diagonal shearing; different channels produce independent 2-D wobble.

features.name: elevation angle
features.showcase_hint: Low elevation gives long dark shadows and grazing highlights; 90 degrees flattens everything to uniform brightness.

features.name: Point light x position
features.showcase_hint: Hotspot slides horizontally across the surface as x changes.

features.name: Point light y position
features.showcase_hint: Hotspot slides vertically across the surface as y changes.

features.name: specularConstant
features.showcase_hint: Highlights fade to nothing at 0.2 and become blinding white at 3 on the same surface.

features.name: surfaceScale (specular)
features.showcase_hint: Higher surfaceScale makes specular glints cluster on steeper, more pronounced bump edges.

features.name: pointsAtY
features.showcase_hint: Lit ellipse moves vertically across the surface as pointsAtY changes.

features.name: pointsAtZ
features.showcase_hint: Non-zero pointsAtZ tilts the cone axis, stretching the lit ellipse and shifting its brightest point.

features.name: Spot focus exponent
features.showcase_hint: Exponent 1 gives a wide soft pool of light; 8 concentrates into a tight bright spot.

features.name: Spot light x/y position
features.showcase_hint: Moving the origin while keeping the aim point changes the lit ellipse's elongation and direction.

features.name: Spot light z height
features.showcase_hint: Raising z widens and dims the lit pool; lowering it tightens and brightens it.

features.name: seed
features.showcase_hint: Identical settings with seeds 1, 2, 3 produce visibly different noise patterns; same seed always reproduces the same texture.

features.name: edgeMode duplicate (default)
features.showcase_hint: Large blur kernel on an image: border pixels are smeared outward with no dark halo at the edges.

features.name: edgeMode none
features.showcase_hint: Blur kernel produces a dark or transparent fringe around the image border because outside pixels count as transparent black.

features.name: edgeMode wrap
features.support_note: all browsers; edge column colours may differ slightly per engine
features.showcase_hint: Shifted identity kernel makes the right edge of the image reappear on the left, like a torus wrap.

features.name: Alpha channel as displacement (default)
features.showcase_hint: With an opaque map the default A selector produces uniform shift only; switching to R restores the wobble.

features.name: operator dilate
features.showcase_hint: Thin text becomes chunky with rounded-square corners; gaps between letters close up.

features.name: operator erode (default)
features.showcase_hint: Bold text becomes hairline; small details and thin strokes disappear entirely as radius grows.

features.name: stitchTiles noStitch (default)
features.showcase_hint: Adjacent noise tiles show hard discontinuities along shared edges.

features.name: type fractalNoise
features.showcase_hint: Soft, smooth cloud-like noise without creases, clearly gentler than the turbulence variant beside it.

features.name: type turbulence (default)
features.showcase_hint: Noise with sharp, vein-like creases and dark seams, resembling marble or crumpled foil.

features.name: Clouds / smoke from fractalNoise
features.showcase_hint: Soft white cloud puffs on blue sky produced purely by fractalNoise alpha remapped through feColorMatrix.

features.name: Box / motion blur via kernel
features.showcase_hint: A 9x1 all-ones kernel smears the image horizontally, imitating motion blur, unlike feGaussianBlur's isotropic softness.

features.name: Diffuse result is opaque; re-mask with SourceAlpha
features.showcase_hint: Raw diffuse output fills the whole filter region with grey; feComposite in SourceAlpha restores the shape silhouette.

features.name: Displacement map read in linearRGB by default
features.support_note: all browsers; mid-grey maps shift unless color-interpolation-filters=sRGB
features.showcase_hint: A flat 50% grey map should displace nothing; in linearRGB the content shifts, with sRGB it stays put.

features.name: Displaced pixels clipped by filter region
features.showcase_hint: Strongly displaced text is cut off at the default 10% margin until the filter region is enlarged.

features.name: Gradient-driven lens / ripple
features.support_note: all browsers; feImage href to a gradient-filled element is Firefox-only, use a data-URI or rect
features.showcase_hint: A circular radial gradient map bulges a checkerboard like a magnifying glass; no randomness.

features.name: Advanced primitives carried unchanged into Filter Effects / CSS filter()
features.showcase_hint: The same feTurbulence/feDisplacementMap filter applied via CSS filter:url(#id) to HTML text renders identically to SVG.

features.name: Performance of heavy primitives
features.support_note: all browsers; large morphology radius, many octaves, big kernels, animated lights repaint every frame
features.showcase_hint: Side-by-side FPS readout while animating a cheap filter versus a large-radius morphology or 8-octave noise.

features.name: Lighting a noise bump map
features.showcase_hint: Turbulence alpha lit by a light source becomes rocky, crumpled-paper or water-surface relief.

features.name: Faux-bold / thin text
features.showcase_hint: The same font shown at several dilated and eroded weights, like a variable-weight axis, without changing font-weight.

features.name: Zero / negative radius behaviour
features.support_note: Filter Effects says pass-through; SVG 1.1 said transparent black; engines differ
features.showcase_hint: radius="0" shows the input unchanged in modern browsers instead of vanishing (exclusion / caveat demo).

features.name: primitiveUnits objectBoundingBox with lights
features.support_note: light x/y/z under objectBoundingBox handled inconsistently across browsers
features.showcase_hint: Same point light declared with fractional coordinates lands at different spots in different browsers.

features.name: Hand-drawn rough edges
features.showcase_hint: Geometric shapes and strokes look pencil-drawn with jittery, imperfect outlines from low-scale displacement.

features.name: Exactly one light-source child per lighting primitive
features.showcase_hint: A lighting primitive with no light child renders nothing; only the first of two light children takes effect.

features.name: Animating displacement scale
features.showcase_hint: Text shakes apart and reassembles as scale oscillates between 0 and 40.

features.name: Animating morphology radius
features.showcase_hint: Letters pulse fat and thin, or an outline ring expands from a shape as radius animates.

features.name: Adding specular result to source
features.showcase_hint: Specular highlights combined via feComposite arithmetic or operator=in show glossy shape; raw specular alone is just white blobs.

features.name: Independent RGBA noise channels
features.showcase_hint: Raw turbulence is rainbow-coloured and semi-transparent; feColorMatrix converts it to grayscale grain or opaque clouds.

features.name: Turbulence has no input; fills subregion
features.showcase_hint: Noise appears across the whole filter region (beyond the shape) until x/y/width/height or a composite with SourceAlpha clips it.

features.name: Noise brightness vs color-interpolation-filters
features.support_note: all browsers; default linearRGB makes noise appear darker
features.showcase_hint: Same feTurbulence twice: linearRGB version looks dark and contrasty, sRGB version lighter and softer.

features.name: Noise granularity under zoom / DPR
features.support_note: Chrome re-samples noise in device space; grain changes with zoom or devicePixelRatio; Firefox stable
features.showcase_hint: Zooming the page or scaling the element changes noise grain size in some browsers while shape scales normally.

features.name: Wood grain / marble veins
features.showcase_hint: Stretched turbulence colourised into brown wood rings or grey marble veins filling a rectangle.

features.name: beginElement() scripted start/restart
features.showcase_hint: An HTML button outside the SVG restarts a begin=indefinite animation on demand.
