features.name: pauseAnimations()
features.showcase_hint: All SMIL animations in the document freeze mid-motion when a pause button is pressed.

features.name: setCurrentTime() timeline scrubbing
features.showcase_hint: Dragging a range slider scrubs every animation forwards and backwards through the document timeline.

features.name: begin attribute (start time list)
features.showcase_hint: Several shapes start animating at staggered times (0s, 1s, 2s) forming a visible cascade.

features.name: by relative delta animation
features.showcase_hint: Shape shifts by +50 units from its base value rather than to an absolute position.

features.name: dur simple duration
features.showcase_hint: Two identical animations with dur 1s and 4s clearly progress at different rates.

features.name: end attribute (event, syncbase or offset)
features.showcase_hint: An indefinite spin stops immediately when a button is clicked or when a sibling animation ends.

features.name: from/to pair
features.showcase_hint: Attribute interpolates between two explicit endpoints, e.g. cx from 20 to 180.

features.name: href targeting a non-parent element
features.showcase_hint: An animate element placed in defs animates a distant rect referenced by #id, not its parent.

features.name: keySplines cubic-Bezier easing per segment
features.showcase_hint: Ball eases in and out (slow-fast-slow) versus a linear sibling moving at constant speed.

features.name: keyTimes pacing of values
features.showcase_hint: Animation lingers at one value for 80% of the duration then rushes through the rest.

features.name: repeatCount (number or indefinite)
features.showcase_hint: Pulse repeats exactly 3 times then stops, while a sibling with indefinite keeps pulsing; 2.5 ends mid-cycle.

features.name: restart (always / whenNotActive / never)
features.showcase_hint: Three click-triggered fades side by side: one restarts on every click, one only when idle, one never again.

features.name: values list (multi-keyframe)
features.showcase_hint: Shape moves through four positions or cycles through five colours in one animation.

features.name: animateMotion keyPoints with keyTimes
features.support_note: all browsers; requires matching keyTimes and calcMode
features.showcase_hint: Mover runs the path backwards (keyPoints 1;0) or pauses mid-route, proving distance control independent of time.

features.name: animateMotion inline path attribute
features.showcase_hint: Object travels along a Bezier route given directly as path data on the animateMotion element.

features.name: accumulate sum across repeats
features.showcase_hint: Each repetition builds on the last, producing a staircase growth rather than a sawtooth reset.

features.name: additive sum on attribute animations
features.showcase_hint: A wobble animation adds onto a slow drift; underlying attribute value plus animated delta is visible.

features.name: event-based begin (click, mouseover, focusin, id.event)
features.support_note: all browsers; touch/pointer event names vary
features.showcase_hint: Hovering or clicking a button-shaped rect triggers a colour flash or move on that or another element.

features.name: begin indefinite (script-only start)
features.showcase_hint: Nothing moves on load; only a scripted beginElement() call starts it.

features.name: syncbase begin id.begin / id.end + offset
features.showcase_hint: A chain of moves where each starts exactly when the previous ends, or 0.5s after another begins.

features.name: calcMode discrete (frame flipping)
features.showcase_hint: Value jumps between listed states with no in-between; a sprite-like frame flip or stepped colour change.

features.name: calcMode paced (constant velocity)
features.support_note: all browsers; keyTimes ignored in paced mode
features.showcase_hint: Point moves at uniform speed across unevenly spaced values, taking longer on longer segments.

features.name: fill freeze (hold end value)
features.showcase_hint: After finishing, the shape stays at its final colour/position instead of snapping back to the original.

features.name: animateMotion rotate auto
features.showcase_hint: An arrow-shaped mover turns to face the direction of travel around every bend of the path.

features.name: stacked animateTransforms with additive=sum
features.showcase_hint: Rotate plus translate animateTransforms combine into an orbit; without additive=sum the later one replaces the first.

features.name: animateTransform type rotate (angle cx cy)
features.showcase_hint: Shape spins around a chosen centre given by the 'angle cx cy' triple, not around the origin.

features.name: colour interpolation of fill/stroke/stop-color
features.support_note: all browsers; interpolates in sRGB, currentColor animatable
features.showcase_hint: Fill fades through intermediate hues from red to blue, including named and hex colour forms.

features.name: animating feTurbulence baseFrequency
features.showcase_hint: Noise texture visibly ripples or breathes as frequency changes, e.g. animated water or smoke.

features.name: animating feGaussianBlur stdDeviation
features.support_note: all browsers; Safari repaints slowly on large blurs
features.showcase_hint: Text goes from sharp to heavily blurred and back.

features.name: animating gradient stops and vector
features.showcase_hint: Gradient stop offset slides and stop-color shifts, producing a moving shimmer or sweep across a fill.

features.name: animations inside use-instanced content
features.support_note: Chrome and Firefox sync all instances; Safari buggy inside use shadow trees
features.showcase_hint: One animated symbol referenced by several use elements shows all instances animating in sync.

features.name: path d morphing with matching commands
features.showcase_hint: A shape smoothly morphs into another because both d strings have identical command sequence and count.

features.name: animating text x/dx/rotate/font-size/textLength/startOffset
features.support_note: all browsers; per-glyph rotate lists interpolate
features.showcase_hint: Letters spread apart, glyphs spin individually, or text slides along a textPath via startOffset.

features.name: animating href of use (symbol swap)
features.showcase_hint: A use instance flips between different symbols at intervals, like an icon sprite cycle.

features.name: animating viewBox (camera pan/zoom)
features.showcase_hint: Whole scene zooms into a detail and pans across while the SVG element's size stays fixed.

features.name: SMIL browser support status 2026
features.support_note: Chrome (2015 deprecation retracted 2016), Firefox and Safari all ship; Safari buggy in use shadow trees
features.showcase_hint: A status panel noting every major engine renders the demo; no polyfill needed.

features.name: beginEvent / endEvent / repeatEvent DOM events
features.support_note: all browsers; onbegin/onend/onrepeat attributes and addEventListener
features.showcase_hint: A counter increments on each repeatEvent and a label changes on endEvent.

features.name: animate element
features.showcase_hint: A circle's radius or fill smoothly changes over time with no script or CSS animation involved.

features.name: animateMotion element
features.showcase_hint: A marker glides along a curved path, its position clearly following a drawn trajectory.

features.name: animateTransform element
features.showcase_hint: A group rotates, scales or translates over time via the transform attribute rather than geometry attributes.

features.name: discard element (remove element at time)
features.support_note: Chrome and Safari 17+ implement it; Firefox ignores it
features.showcase_hint: A shape vanishes from the DOM at a scheduled time or after another animation ends, permanently.

features.name: mpath (reference an existing path for motion)
features.support_note: all browsers; plain href accepted alongside xlink:href
features.showcase_hint: Object follows a visible stroked path element defined elsewhere in the document, not an inline path string.

features.name: set element (discrete value switch)
features.showcase_hint: A shape snaps to a new colour or visibility at a given time and stays there, with no interpolation.

features.name: animVal vs baseVal while animating
features.showcase_hint: Two readouts: baseVal stays constant while animVal changes each frame as the radius animates.

features.name: beginElementAt(offset)
features.showcase_hint: Calling with -1 starts the animation already one second in; with 2 schedules a delayed start.

features.name: endElement() scripted stop
features.showcase_hint: A stop button halts an indefinite animation, which then freezes or snaps back per fill.

features.name: SVGAnimationElement.getCurrentTime()
features.showcase_hint: A live readout of the animation's own current time updates alongside the moving shape.

features.name: getSimpleDuration()
features.support_note: all browsers; throws for indefinite dur
features.showcase_hint: Progress bar drawn from currentTime / simpleDuration tracks the animation.

features.name: getStartTime()
features.support_note: all browsers; throws when no current interval
features.showcase_hint: Overlay text prints the animation's scheduled start time in document seconds.

features.name: targetElement property
features.showcase_hint: Script highlights whichever element an href-targeted animation actually drives.

features.name: animationsPaused()
features.showcase_hint: Toggle button label switches between Pause and Play based on the reported paused state.

features.name: SVGSVGElement.getCurrentTime() document time
features.showcase_hint: A clock readout shows the shared document timeline all animations are synced to.

features.name: unpauseAnimations()
features.showcase_hint: Frozen animations resume from exactly where they stopped.

features.name: TimeEvent interface (detail)
features.support_note: removed from SVG 2; browsers dispatch plain Event/TimeEvent inconsistently
features.showcase_hint: event.detail of repeatEvent would show the iteration number; not reliable. Explicit exclusion.

features.name: attributeName target attribute/property
features.showcase_hint: Same element animated on r, fill and opacity by three sibling animate elements with different attributeName.

features.name: attributeType CSS / XML / auto
features.support_note: dropped from SVG 2; browsers still parse it as a hint
features.showcase_hint: Explicit attributeType=CSS versus XML shows no visible difference in modern browsers. Explicit exclusion.

features.name: max active duration
features.support_note: Chrome and Firefox honour it; WebKit handling inconsistent
features.showcase_hint: Indefinite repeat is cut off after max seconds even though repeatCount says forever.

features.name: min active duration
features.support_note: Chrome and Firefox honour it; WebKit handling inconsistent
features.showcase_hint: Short-dur animation stays active (frozen or repeating) until min elapses before later begins may restart it.

features.name: onbegin/onend/onrepeat event attributes
features.showcase_hint: Inline onrepeat handler increments a counter text on each repeat without addEventListener.

features.name: repeatDur total repeat time
features.showcase_hint: A 1s animation repeats but stops after 3.5s total, ending halfway through its fourth cycle.

features.name: to-only animation (blend from base value)
features.showcase_hint: Only a target value is given; the animation starts from whatever the element's current value is.

features.name: animateMotion origin attribute
features.support_note: no browser implements; always behaves as default
features.showcase_hint: Would shift the motion origin; nothing visible changes. Explicit exclusion.

features.name: animateTransform type selector
features.showcase_hint: Same element spins (rotate) or pulses (scale) depending solely on the type attribute value.

features.name: discard begin time
features.showcase_hint: Element is removed exactly when the begin offset or syncbase (id.end) fires.

features.name: discard href target
features.showcase_hint: A discard placed in defs removes a distant element referenced by id rather than its parent.

features.name: mpath href
features.showcase_hint: Changing the href to another path id makes the mover switch to that path's route.

features.name: set to value
features.showcase_hint: Fill snaps to the given colour at begin time and holds for the active duration.

features.name: timelinebegin
features.showcase_hint: No visible effect; would start the timeline at load instead of onLoad. Explicit exclusion.

features.name: accessKey(key) begin
features.support_note: Firefox and Chrome respond to the key; WebKit parses but rarely fires
features.showcase_hint: Pressing a letter key on the keyboard starts the animation with no mouse interaction.

features.name: negative begin offset (start mid-way)
features.showcase_hint: begin=-1s shows the animation already partway through at document load rather than from its start.

features.name: begin clock-value offset
features.support_note: all browsers; supports s, ms, min, h and hh:mm:ss forms
features.showcase_hint: Animation starts after a visible delay written as '2.5s', '500ms' or '00:00:02'.

features.name: syncbase on repeat iteration id.repeat(n)
features.support_note: Chrome and Firefox; WebKit support incomplete
features.showcase_hint: A second shape lights up precisely when a looping animation starts its third iteration.

features.name: wallclock() begin
features.showcase_hint: Would start at a real-world clock time; browsers treat it as never. Explicit exclusion.

features.name: calcMode linear (default)
features.showcase_hint: Equal time per values segment regardless of distance; short segments look slow, long segments fast.

features.name: calcMode spline
features.showcase_hint: Motion follows custom easing curves; a bounce-like overshoot is visible when compared to linear.

features.name: dur media
features.showcase_hint: Would tie duration to media length; treated as invalid. Explicit exclusion.

features.name: fill remove (default snap-back)
features.showcase_hint: Shape visibly jumps back to its base value the instant the animation's active duration ends.

features.name: repeatCount indefinite
features.showcase_hint: Endless loop that never stops on its own.

features.name: restart never
features.showcase_hint: Click-triggered animation plays once; further clicks do nothing for the document lifetime.

features.name: restart whenNotActive
features.showcase_hint: Rapid clicks do not restart a running fade; clicks only work again after it finishes.

features.name: animateMotion fixed rotate angle
features.showcase_hint: Mover stays at a constant tilt (e.g. 45 degrees) regardless of the path direction.

features.name: animateMotion rotate auto-reverse
features.showcase_hint: Mover points 180 degrees against the direction of travel, tail-first, while still following the curve.

features.name: animateTransform accumulate across repeats
features.showcase_hint: Each repeat starts where the previous ended, so a 90-degree rotation keeps advancing rather than snapping back.

features.name: animateTransform type scale
features.showcase_hint: Shape grows and shrinks about the origin; non-uniform 'sx sy' values stretch it anisotropically.

features.name: animateTransform type skewX
features.showcase_hint: Rectangle leans sideways into a parallelogram and back as the skew angle animates.

features.name: animateTransform type skewY
features.showcase_hint: Rectangle's vertical edges tilt as the skewY angle animates, visibly different from skewX.

features.name: animateTransform type translate
features.showcase_hint: Group slides across the canvas along x/y while its internal geometry stays unchanged.

features.name: animating fePointLight/feSpotLight x y z
features.showcase_hint: Specular highlight on a lit surface travels across it as the light source moves.

features.name: d command mismatch falls back to discrete
features.support_note: all browsers snap with no interpolation
features.showcase_hint: Mismatched command counts produce a hard jump between shapes at the midpoint instead of a morph.

features.name: animating polygon/polyline points
features.support_note: all browsers; point count must match
features.showcase_hint: A polygon's vertices slide so a star turns into a pentagon and back.

features.name: animate on transform is ignored; animateTransform required
features.showcase_hint: An <animate attributeName=transform> does nothing while the sibling animateTransform visibly spins the shape.

features.name: animateMotion defaults to calcMode paced
features.showcase_hint: Constant speed along unequal path segments; switching to linear makes short segments visibly slower.

features.name: motion transform composed after the transform attribute
features.showcase_hint: A rotated/scaled group still follows a motion path in user space; motion is applied on top of its own transform.

features.name: animateMotion via from/to/values coordinate pairs
features.showcase_hint: Object moves between listed x,y points in straight segments without any path attribute.

features.name: additive=sum keeps the static transform attribute
features.showcase_hint: Element with a static transform keeps its offset while animating; a replace animation visibly jumps to the origin.

features.name: animation sandwich model (later animation wins)
features.showcase_hint: Two animations of the same attribute: the later document-order one visibly overrides while both are active.

features.name: script-inserted animation elements start running
features.showcase_hint: Clicking a button appends an animate element and the target immediately begins moving.

features.name: semicolon-separated begin list
features.showcase_hint: Animation fires at 0s, again at 3s, and additionally on every click, all from one begin attribute.

features.name: set on visibility/display to show or hide at a time
features.showcase_hint: A hidden label appears after 2s or on click and vanishes again when the set's duration ends.

features.name: SMIL runs inside img and CSS background
features.support_note: all browsers; scripts do not run there, only SMIL
features.showcase_hint: The same SVG shown via img still animates, while a scripted sibling stays static.

features.name: animations do not run in resource documents
features.support_note: all browsers freeze SMIL in externally referenced masks/patterns/fonts
features.showcase_hint: The same animated SVG plays as but stays static when used as an external mask resource.

features.name: SMIL animated value beats author CSS
features.support_note: all browsers override non-important CSS; !important and CSS animation interplay varies
features.showcase_hint: A stylesheet sets fill red, yet the SMIL fill animation visibly runs; adding !important stops it.

features.name: animation elements inside view
features.support_note: no browser runs animations declared as children of <view>
features.showcase_hint: Navigating to #viewId would start an animation; browsers only apply the viewBox. Explicit exclusion.

features.name: animateColor element
features.support_note: removed from SVG 2 and all browsers; Firefox never supported
features.showcase_hint: Produces no change; the same values on <animate attributeName=fill> cycle colours. Explicit exclusion.

features.name: nested SVG animation element (SVG Tiny 1.2)
features.support_note: SVG Tiny 1.2 only; no current browser
features.showcase_hint: Would embed an external animated SVG with its own timeline; renders nothing. Explicit exclusion.

features.name: prefetch resource element (SVG Tiny 1.2)
features.support_note: SVG Tiny 1.2 only; no current browser
features.showcase_hint: No visible output; a hint to preload a resource before the timeline needs it. Explicit exclusion.

features.name: DOMMatrix construction and multiplication
features.support_note: all browsers; SVGMatrix is an alias
features.showcase_hint: A matrix built by chaining translate/rotate/scale is applied as transform attribute string to a shape.

features.name: DOMPoint.matrixTransform
features.showcase_hint: Corners of a transformed rect are recomputed and marked with circles that stay on the corners after rotation.

features.name: Web Animations API on SVG elements
features.support_note: all browsers; only CSS-animatable properties, not plain attributes
features.showcase_hint: Script calls el.animate([{opacity:0},{opacity:1}], 1000) and shapes fade in without CSS keyframes.

features.name: IntersectionObserver with SVG elements
features.showcase_hint: Chart shapes animate in only when scrolled into view; already-visible ones do not replay.

features.name: ResizeObserver on SVG elements
features.support_note: all browsers; SVG targets report bounding-box size
features.showcase_hint: A responsive svg relayouts labels when its container resizes; observed rect size shown live.

features.name: viewBox.baseVal scripted pan and zoom
features.showcase_hint: Wheel and drag modify viewBox.baseVal.x/y/width producing smooth zoom and pan of the scene.

features.name: dataset and data-* attributes on SVG elements
features.showcase_hint: Clicking a map region shows its name read from el.dataset.region; CSS [data-state] selectors colour states.

features.name: getCTM
features.showcase_hint: A point drawn in a nested transformed group is mapped to root coordinates and marked there with a crosshair.

features.name: getScreenCTM
features.showcase_hint: Draggable shapes follow the mouse correctly inside a scaled viewBox by inverting getScreenCTM.

features.name: checkIntersection / checkEnclosure
features.support_note: Chrome and Safari (bbox-based); Firefox not implemented
features.showcase_hint: Dragging a selection box highlights shapes whose bbox intersects (yellow) or is fully enclosed (green).

features.name: transform.baseVal SVGTransformList manipulation
features.showcase_hint: Script appends a rotate transform item to a rect's list and consolidate() merges it; element visibly rotates.

features.name: Reading computed paint values
features.showcase_hint: Label displays getComputedStyle(el).fill resolved to rgb() and currentColor resolved to the actual colour.

features.name: requestAnimationFrame-driven attribute updates
features.showcase_hint: A polygon's points attribute is rewritten each frame producing a wobbling shape impossible with declarative animation.

features.name: Mapping pointer coordinates to SVG user space
features.showcase_hint: Clicking anywhere places a dot exactly under the cursor despite preserveAspectRatio letterboxing and CSS scaling.

features.name: Presentation attribute vs CSS cascade precedence
features.showcase_hint: Rect with fill="red" attribute renders blue because any author stylesheet rule wins; inline style and !important rank above that.

features.name: Script execution context of embedded SVG
features.support_note: all browsers: scripts blocked in img/CSS/external use; cross-origin object isolated
features.showcase_hint: Same SVG shown via (static, no script),

features.name: Serialize SVG and draw to canvas / export PNG
features.support_note: all browsers; external images/fonts must be inlined or canvas taints
features.showcase_hint: A Rasterize button shows a pixel-identical PNG copy of the vector scene rendered on a canvas.

features.name: 3D transform functions on SVG elements
features.support_note: Rendered flattened; no 3D rendering context inside SVG; engines differ
features.showcase_hint: A rect flips with rotateY(60deg) appearing foreshortened; perspective() gives the near edge a larger size.

features.name: Scroll-driven animations on SVG
features.showcase_hint: Scrolling the page draws a path's stroke-dashoffset progressively; nothing moves while idle.

features.name: Geometry attributes as CSS properties (x, y, width, height, cx, cy, r, rx, ry)
features.support_note: Chrome and Safari; Firefox support incomplete
features.showcase_hint: A rect resized via CSS rule width:200px and a circle whose r is set in a :hover rule, with transition.

features.name: CSS @keyframes on SVG presentation properties
features.support_note: all browsers; attribute-only values (points, viewBox) not animatable
features.showcase_hint: A shape whose fill cycles hue and opacity pulses continuously with no SMIL or script in the markup.

features.name: CSS keyframe animation of fill, stroke, opacity, dashoffset
features.showcase_hint: Shape cycling through colours and pulsing stroke-width using @keyframes, no SMIL or script.

features.name: Presentation attributes lose to any CSS rule
features.showcase_hint: Shape with fill=red attribute renders blue because a stylesheet rule sets fill:blue; inline style beats both.

features.name: CSS transitions on SVG presentation properties
features.showcase_hint: Hovering a circle smoothly tweens stroke-width and fill over 300ms instead of snapping.

features.name: offset-distance
features.showcase_hint: Keyframes animate offset-distance 0% to 100%, moving the marker along the path; a slider variant sets it statically.

features.name: offset-path: path() motion path
features.showcase_hint: A dot travels along a visible curved path using CSS only; no animateMotion element present.

features.name: offset-rotate auto / reverse / angle
features.support_note: all browsers; Safari rotation quirks on SVG children
features.showcase_hint: Three arrows follow the same path: one tangent-aligned, one reversed, one keeping fixed 0deg orientation.

features.name: Individual transform properties rotate / scale / translate
features.showcase_hint: Independent keyframes animate rotate and scale separately on one element without a combined transform list.

features.name: CSS transform property on SVG elements
features.showcase_hint: Elements rotated/scaled via stylesheet rules (rotate(45deg)) visibly overriding the transform attribute.

features.name: transform-box reference box
features.showcase_hint: Same off-centre shape with transform-origin:center: orbits the viewBox centre under view-box, spins in place under fill-box.

features.name: transform-origin on SVG
features.support_note: all browsers; SVG default is 0 0, not 50% 50%
features.showcase_hint: Two identical squares spin: one around the viewport origin (default) and one around its own centre.

features.name: Animation object control (pause, reverse, playbackRate, currentTime)
features.showcase_hint: Buttons pause, reverse and speed up a moving shape; a range input scrubs currentTime.

features.name: Setting paint via element.style
features.showcase_hint: Button click sets el.style.fill and el.style.strokeDasharray, instantly restyling the shape.

features.name: document.getAnimations / element.getAnimations
features.showcase_hint: One button pauses every CSS and WAAPI animation on the page at once, including those declared in stylesheets.

features.name: classList on SVG elements
features.support_note: all browsers; className is SVGAnimatedString, use classList
features.showcase_hint: Clicking toggles an 'active' class and the shape changes colour via a CSS rule.

features.name: getBoundingClientRect on SVG elements
features.showcase_hint: HTML overlay div positioned exactly over a rotated SVG element using its screen-space rect.

features.name: el.style inline property writes on SVG elements
features.showcase_hint: Script sets el.style.fill and el.style.transform; shapes recolour and move without attribute changes.

features.name: href.baseVal / className.baseVal
features.showcase_hint: A <use> switches symbols when script sets use.href.baseVal, visibly swapping the icon.

features.name: beginEvent / endEvent / repeatEvent listeners
features.showcase_hint: A counter increments on each repeatEvent and the background flashes on endEvent.

features.name: getBBox with SVGBoundingBoxOptions (fill/stroke/markers/clipped)
features.support_note: Firefox only; Chrome and Safari ignore the options dictionary
features.showcase_hint: In Firefox the box from getBBox({stroke:true}) encloses the stroke; elsewhere the box is unchanged.

features.name: getPresentationAttribute, SVGPaint, SVGColor removed
features.support_note: Removed from SVG 2; Chrome and Firefox dropped, Safari retains SVGPaint
features.showcase_hint: Exclusion: typeof SVGPaint undefined in Chrome; fill read via getComputedStyle instead.

features.name: SVGElementInstance / SVGElementInstanceList removed
features.support_note: Removed in SVG 2; Chrome dropped in 2016, Firefox and Safari never exposed it
features.showcase_hint: Exclusion: useElement.instanceRoot is undefined; event.target is the <use> itself.

features.name: getTransformToElement removed
features.support_note: Removed from SVG 2, Chrome 48 and Firefox; Safari still exposes
features.showcase_hint: Exclusion: method undefined; element-to-element matrix computed via getScreenCTM().inverse().multiply() instead.

features.name: nearestViewportElement / farthestViewportElement
features.support_note: Deprecated in SVG 2; still exposed by browsers
features.showcase_hint: Label reports which nested <svg> is the nearest viewport of a clicked shape.

features.name: SVGLength unit conversion
features.showcase_hint: A readout shows a 50% width converted to px user units, matching the rendered rect edge.

features.name: SVGMatrix / SVGPoint / SVGRect legacy interfaces
features.support_note: Aliased to DOMMatrix/DOMPoint/DOMRect in all browsers; names retained
features.showcase_hint: Label shows svg.createSVGMatrix() instanceof DOMMatrix is true while a transform computed through it renders.

features.name: createSVGPoint / createSVGMatrix / createSVGLength legacy factories
features.support_note: all browsers; superseded by DOMPoint/DOMMatrix constructors
features.showcase_hint: Same coordinate mapping demo implemented with svg.createSVGPoint() gives identical crosshair placement.

features.name: createSVGRect
features.showcase_hint: A rubber-band selection rectangle is built as SVGRect for intersection tests and drawn as dashed outline.

features.name: createSVGTransform / createSVGTransformFromMatrix
features.showcase_hint: A DOMMatrix is wrapped into a transform item and inserted into a group's list; the group jumps accordingly.

features.name: currentView / useCurrentView / SVGViewSpec / pixelUnitToMillimeterX
features.support_note: Removed from SVG 2 and from browsers
features.showcase_hint: Exclusion: feature-detect list shows these members undefined while currentScale still works.

features.name: suspendRedraw / unsuspendRedraw / forceRedraw / deselectAll
features.support_note: Kept as no-ops or removed; no rendering effect anywhere
features.showcase_hint: Exclusion: calling suspendRedraw before many updates shows no visible batching difference.

features.name: SVGTransform setRotate / setTranslate / setScale / setMatrix
features.showcase_hint: A slider updates a single SVGTransform item's angle around a centre without rebuilding the attribute string.

features.name: SVGUnknownElement interface
features.support_note: No browser exposes SVGUnknownElement; unknown svg-namespace elements are plain SVGElement
features.showcase_hint: Exclusion: createElementNS(svgNS,'foo').constructor.name prints SVGElement.

features.name: SVGZoomEvent removed
features.support_note: Removed in SVG 2 and from all browsers
features.showcase_hint: Exclusion: typeof SVGZoomEvent is undefined; pinch-zoom fires no SVG-specific event.

features.name: script crossorigin
features.showcase_hint: Cross-origin script errors show a full stack in console instead of 'Script error'.

features.name: style element type
features.showcase_hint: No visible difference from omitting it; a non-CSS type disables the sheet.

features.name: contentStyleType
features.support_note: Removed in SVG 2; ignored by all browsers
features.showcase_hint: Exclusion: attribute present, no visible effect.

features.name: module scripts in SVG
features.support_note: Chromium and Firefox; WebKit support unverified
features.showcase_hint: SVG script with type=module imports a helper and renders an imported shape generator's output.

features.name: CSS/SMIL animations run inside img but scripts do not
features.support_note: all browsers; external resources also blocked in img
features.showcase_hint: An SVG loaded via still spins via CSS keyframes while its script-driven counter stays at 0.

features.name: Scripting an embedded SVG via contentDocument
features.showcase_hint: HTML button recolours a shape inside a same-origin <object> SVG through object.contentDocument.

features.name: getBBox on display:none or detached elements
features.support_note: all browsers return empty rect; Firefox historically threw
features.showcase_hint: A hidden shape reports a 0x0 box; demo toggles display to obtain a real box before measuring.

features.name: innerHTML / insertAdjacentHTML inside an svg element
features.support_note: all browsers; in HTML documents the parser applies SVG foreign-content rules
features.showcase_hint: Markup string injected into <svg> renders as shapes without namespace declarations.

features.name: Presentation attributes allowed on any SVG element
features.support_note: all browsers; fill on <g> or <defs> cascades to children
features.showcase_hint: A <g fill="red"> makes all children red; a <defs fill> colours the referenced symbol content.

features.name: CSS unit syntax inside transform attribute
features.support_note: Chrome and Firefox accept 45deg/px units; WebKit inconsistent
features.showcase_hint: Two rects: transform="rotate(45)" and transform="rotate(45deg)" render identically where supported.

features.name: WAAPI cannot animate non-CSS SVG attributes
features.support_note: points, viewBox, x1/y1, dx are not CSS properties; no engine animates them via animate()
features.showcase_hint: Exclusion: animate() on 'points' has no effect while a rAF loop rewriting the attribute moves the polygon.

features.name: setAttributeNS with the xlink namespace for href
features.support_note: xlink:href deprecated in SVG 2; plain href works everywhere
features.showcase_hint: Two <use> elements: one set via setAttribute('href'), one via setAttributeNS(xlink) — both render the symbol.

features.name: CSS animation of gradient stops inside defs
features.showcase_hint: A gradient-filled rect slowly shifts colours because stop-color and stop-opacity are keyframe-animated in defs.

features.name: animation-composition add / accumulate
features.showcase_hint: A rotating element keeps its base translate because the keyframe transform is composed additively rather than replaced.

features.name: :hover state with fill/stroke transition
features.showcase_hint: Hovering a shape smoothly fades its fill and thickens its stroke via CSS transition.

features.name: @property registered custom property animation
features.showcase_hint: A registered --angle animates smoothly and drives a rotation; the unregistered version jumps between values.

features.name: @starting-style entry transitions
features.showcase_hint: Dynamically inserted circles fade and scale in from a starting style on their first frame.

features.name: transition-behavior: allow-discrete
features.showcase_hint: Toggling visibility:hidden on a shape delays disappearance until the opacity transition ends.

features.name: offset-anchor
features.showcase_hint: A rect moves with its top-left corner (not centre) glued to the path, visibly offset from the line.

features.name: offset-position
features.showcase_hint: Ray motion starts from an explicit offset-position point rather than the element's own position.

features.name: perspective on SVG children
features.support_note: Applies flattened; behaviour varies across engines
features.showcase_hint: Group with perspective makes a rotateX child appear trapezoidal instead of merely squashed.

features.name: offset-path: ray()
features.showcase_hint: Elements shoot outward along straight rays at set angles from their offset-position, no path data present.

features.name: offset-path: url(#shape) and basic shapes with coord-box
features.support_note: Chrome 116+, Firefox 122+; Safari lacks url() references and coord-box
features.showcase_hint: A marker follows an existing <path id> via offset-path: url(#track), or a circle()/inset() basic shape, without duplicated path data.

features.name: transform-box: fill-box
features.showcase_hint: The same shape now rotates in place around its own geometry centre with transform-origin:center.

features.name: transform-box: stroke-box
features.showcase_hint: A thick-stroked shape's percentage transform-origin shifts outward compared with fill-box, visibly changing the pivot.

features.name: transform-box: view-box (default)
features.showcase_hint: transform-origin:50% 50% places the pivot at the viewBox centre, so an off-centre shape orbits around it.

features.name: transform-style: preserve-3d inside SVG
features.support_note: No browser creates 3D contexts for SVG descendants; always flattened
features.showcase_hint: Exclusion: two intersecting 3D-rotated rects never interpenetrate; painting order stays document order.

features.name: element.transform.baseVal list manipulation
features.support_note: all browsers; animVal reflects SMIL animation
features.showcase_hint: Script appends SVGTransform items one by one and the shape visibly steps through translate, then rotate, then scale.

features.name: meetOrSlice = slice (cover and crop)
features.showcase_hint: Same viewBox in a wide viewport: meet leaves side gaps, slice fills the viewport and crops top and bottom.

features.name: Sub-device-pixel strokes and zero width under downscale
features.support_note: all browsers; antialiasing intensity differs per engine
features.showcase_hint: Lines with stroke-width 0.1 fade to faint grey under scale(0.2), stroke-width 0 disappears, non-scaling-stroke stays solid.

features.name: translate(0.5 0.5) for crisp 1px lines
features.showcase_hint: Two 1px grids side by side: integer-aligned one blurs into 2px grey lines, the half-pixel-offset one is sharp black.

features.name: Isometric / axonometric projection via matrix()
features.showcase_hint: Three flat squares with different matrices assemble into a convincing 3D cube (top, left, right faces) in isometric view.

features.name: Absolute units px, mm, cm, in, pt, pc at 96 dpi
features.showcase_hint: Rules of width 1in, 2.54cm, 25.4mm, 72pt, 6pc and 96px line up at exactly the same length.

features.name: em and rem lengths on geometry
features.support_note: all browsers; rem resolves against document root font-size
features.showcase_hint: Circle r='1em' grows when the parent group's font-size doubles; an r='1rem' sibling stays fixed.

features.name: Screen to user space via getScreenCTM().inverse() and DOMPoint
features.showcase_hint: Clicking anywhere on a panned, zoomed and rotated canvas places a marker precisely under the cursor.

features.name: Percentages resolve against the nearest viewport, not the root
features.showcase_hint: rect width='50%' inside a 100px nested svg is 50px while a sibling in the 400px root is 200px.

features.name: Mirroring with negative scale
features.showcase_hint: Text or asymmetric glyph flipped horizontally by scale(-1 1) and vertically by scale(1 -1), readable only in a mirror.

features.name: Nested <g> transforms accumulate into the CTM
features.showcase_hint: Three nested groups each rotating 15 degrees produce a child turned 45 degrees; robot-arm style chained segments.

features.name: Nested <svg> with x/y/width/height and its own viewBox
features.showcase_hint: Inner <svg> positioned at x/y remaps its 0..10 viewBox into a 100px box; same child coordinates draw at a different scale.

features.name: objectBoundingBox units stretch with non-square bounding boxes
features.showcase_hint: Radial gradient or circular clipPath in objectBoundingBox units becomes elliptical on a wide rectangle; userSpaceOnUse copy stays round.

features.name: Non-axis percentages use the normalized diagonal sqrt((w²+h²)/2)
features.showcase_hint: circle r='50%' in a 400x100 viewport has a radius near 146 user units, larger than half the height and smaller than half the width.

features.name: Stroke width and dashes scale with the transform
features.showcase_hint: Same stroke-width='2' dashed line under scale(3) shows a thick stroke and lengthened dashes beside the unscaled original.

features.name: Transform list composition order (right-to-left application)
features.showcase_hint: translate(100 0) rotate(45) versus rotate(45) translate(100 0) land the same shape in visibly different positions.

features.name: viewBox min-x / min-y as camera offset
features.showcase_hint: Shifting viewBox origin from 0 0 to 50 0 scrolls the scene left by half its width with no element edits.

features.name: Smaller viewBox magnifies (zoom in), larger shrinks (zoom out)
features.showcase_hint: Same scene at viewBox 0 0 100 100 versus 25 25 50 50: the second is a 2x close-up of the centre.

features.name: Negative viewBox origin centring (0,0) in the viewport
features.showcase_hint: viewBox='-50 -50 100 100' with axes drawn through (0,0) shows the origin at the centre of the canvas.

features.name: y axis points down, positive angles rotate clockwise
features.showcase_hint: Axes drawn from the origin with y increasing downward; rotate(30) turns an arrow clockwise, opposite to textbook mathematical convention.

features.name: CSS translate / rotate / scale properties on SVG elements
features.showcase_hint: rotate:45deg and scale:1.5 declared as separate properties, hover changing only rotate while scale persists.

features.name: CSS transform overrides the transform attribute (presentation attribute specificity zero)
features.showcase_hint: Element with transform attribute translate(100 0) and CSS transform:none appears untranslated; any selector wins over the attribute.

features.name: CSS transitions and @keyframes animating transform on SVG elements
features.showcase_hint: Gear paths spinning continuously via @keyframes rotate, and a hovered shape smoothly scaling up with transition.

features.name: matrix(a b c d e f) general affine
features.showcase_hint: A single matrix() reproduces a rotate+scale+translate combination pixel-for-pixel next to the equivalent function list.

features.name: rotate(angle) about the origin
features.showcase_hint: Rectangle far from origin swings on an arc around (0,0), proving rotation pivots at the user-space origin, not the shape centre.

features.name: rotate(angle cx cy) three-argument form
features.support_note: all browsers; attribute only, CSS rotate() has no centre arguments
features.showcase_hint: Rectangle spins in place around a marked pivot dot; the equivalent translate-rotate-translate list drawn beside it overlaps exactly.

features.name: scale(sx sy)
features.showcase_hint: Same square rendered at scale(2), scale(0.5) and scale(2 0.5); stroke thickness visibly scales with the shape.

features.name: skewX(angle)
features.showcase_hint: Rectangle sheared into a parallelogram with slanted vertical edges while horizontal edges stay level.

features.name: skewY(angle)
features.showcase_hint: Rectangle sheared so horizontal edges tilt while vertical edges remain upright, contrasting with skewX.

features.name: translate(tx ty)
features.showcase_hint: Grid of clones offset by translate; single-argument translate(tx) leaves y unchanged, shown by a horizontal-only shift.

features.name: DOMMatrix inverse / multiply / rotate / scale helpers
features.showcase_hint: A matrix built with DOMMatrix chaining written into transform.baseVal reproduces an attribute-authored transform exactly.

features.name: createSVGMatrix / createSVGTransform / createSVGPoint legacy factories
features.support_note: SVGMatrix and SVGPoint replaced by DOMMatrix and DOMPoint in SVG 2; still shipping as aliases
features.showcase_hint: Legacy createSVGMatrix().rotate(30) applied to a shape renders the same as a DOMMatrix path.

features.name: SVGTransformList.consolidate() collapses list into one matrix
features.showcase_hint: Serialized transform attribute changes from three functions to a single matrix() while the render stays identical.

features.name: preserveAspectRatio defer keyword removed
features.support_note: removed in SVG 2; browsers ignore defer
features.showcase_hint: An <image preserveAspectRatio='defer xMidYMid'> is fitted exactly as without defer.

features.name: Alignment keywords xMin/xMid/xMax x YMin/YMid/YMax
features.showcase_hint: Nine-cell sheet showing the same square viewBox parked in each corner, edge and centre of a wide viewport.

features.name: Normative bounding box algorithm and objectBoundingBox
features.support_note: all browsers; getBBox of an empty group returns 0,0,0,0
features.showcase_hint: A gradient in objectBoundingBox units on a transformed group fits the group's untransformed bbox.

features.name: CSS transform on pattern and gradient elements
features.support_note: only patternTransform/gradientTransform attributes work; CSS transform on these elements ignored in most browsers
features.showcase_hint: A pattern given style='transform:rotate(45deg)' renders unrotated while the patternTransform sibling is rotated.

features.name: CSS-only units (vw, vh, ch, Q) in geometry attributes
features.support_note: accepted in CSS properties; rejected in attributes by Firefox and Safari, partly accepted by Chrome
features.showcase_hint: rect width='50vw' shows in one browser and vanishes in another; the same value via CSS width works everywhere.

features.name: Filter primitives operate in the element's transformed user space
features.showcase_hint: Drop shadow offset dx=5 dy=5 on a rect rotated 180 degrees falls up-left instead of down-right.

features.name: Parse error discards the whole transform attribute
features.showcase_hint: transform='translate(50 50) bogus(1)' leaves the shape untransformed at the origin instead of partially translated.

features.name: Zero or negative viewBox width/height disables rendering
features.showcase_hint: An <svg> with viewBox='0 0 0 100' renders nothing at all, while its sibling with a valid viewBox shows content.

features.name: Floating-point precision loss with huge coordinates and tiny scales
features.support_note: all browsers degrade; Chrome shows jitter earlier due to float32 rasterization
features.showcase_hint: Coordinates near 1e7 under scale(1e-6) produce wobbling, misaligned edges compared with the same drawing authored near the origin.

features.name: transform on a nested <svg> element
features.support_note: Chrome and Firefox apply it; Safari and older engines ignore transform on inner svg
features.showcase_hint: Inner <svg transform='rotate(45)'> rotates its whole clipped viewport as a tilted window.

features.name: Non-uniform scale turns the stroke pen into an ellipse
features.showcase_hint: Circle under scale(4 1) has a thick stroke at the sides and a thin stroke at top and bottom.

features.name: Scaling about a point via translate-scale-translate
features.showcase_hint: Shape grows from its own centre with translate(cx cy) scale(2) translate(-cx -cy) while the plain scale(2) copy drifts away from the origin.

features.name: Non-invertible transform (scale(0), degenerate matrix)
features.support_note: all browsers; getScreenCTM().inverse() throws for singular matrices
features.showcase_hint: Element with scale(1 0) collapses to nothing while a sibling with scale(1 0.01) renders as a thin sliver.

features.name: Attribute syntax: optional commas/whitespace, unitless numbers, degrees implied
features.showcase_hint: Shapes using 'translate(10,20)rotate(30)' and 'translate(10 20) rotate(30)' render identically; a px unit in the attribute makes the transform vanish in Safari.

features.name: transform on <tspan> is ignored
features.support_note: no browser applies transform to tspan; use text-level transform or the rotate attribute
features.showcase_hint: A tspan with transform='rotate(45)' stays unrotated inline in its text line.

features.name: Default transform-origin is 0 0 for SVG content, 50% 50% for HTML
features.showcase_hint: CSS rotate(20deg) on an HTML div turns about its centre; the same rule on an inner SVG rect swings it around the canvas origin.

features.name: translate() versus x/y attributes for positioning
features.showcase_hint: Two rects at the same spot, one via x/y and one via translate; only the translated one carries its userSpaceOnUse gradient and filter region along.

features.name: Unitless numbers accepted for SVG properties in CSS
features.support_note: all browsers accept stroke-width:3 in CSS on SVG elements
features.showcase_hint: style='stroke-width:3' renders the same width as stroke-width='3px', unlike HTML CSS where unitless is invalid.

features.name: Physical units inside a viewBox are converted then rescaled
features.showcase_hint: A rect width='1in' inside a viewBox scaled 2x renders two inches on screen, proving units are not physically accurate there.

features.name: <use> x/y is an extra translate applied after its transform
features.showcase_hint: use x='100' with transform='rotate(45)' lands where rotate(45) translate(100 0) would, not where translate then rotate would.

features.name: viewBox-only root svg sizes responsively via intrinsic aspect ratio
features.support_note: all browsers; Safari historically needed explicit width
features.showcase_hint: Inline svg with viewBox but no width/height fills its container width and keeps the viewBox aspect as the container resizes.

features.name: 3D transforms (rotateX/rotateY/perspective) on inner SVG elements
features.support_note: rendered flattened; perspective and preserve-3d on inner SVG elements inconsistent across engines
features.showcase_hint: A rect with rotateY(60deg) foreshortens into a narrower shape; nested perspective shows no real depth.

features.name: CSS units and functions in the transform attribute
features.support_note: Chrome and Firefox accept rotate(45deg), translate(1em); WebKit rejects unit-bearing attribute values
features.showcase_hint: transform='rotate(45deg)' tilts the shape in Chrome and Firefox; it is ignored in Safari.

features.name: CSS transform on the inline <svg> root behaves like an HTML box
features.showcase_hint: Whole inline svg rotated about its centre (border-box origin) with a 3D tilt, unlike inner elements which pivot at 0 0.

features.name: CSS transform requires units (px, deg) and single-angle rotate
features.showcase_hint: style='transform:translate(50px,20px) rotate(45deg)' works while style='transform:translate(50 20)' is dropped and leaves the shape in place.

features.name: CSS zoom property on SVG content
features.support_note: applies to the inline svg root everywhere; zoom on inner SVG elements ignored or inconsistent
features.showcase_hint: svg{zoom:2} doubles the rendered size and layout box, unlike transform:scale(2) which overflows neighbours.

features.name: transform-box: content-box / border-box on SVG elements
features.support_note: all browsers; both resolve to fill-box / stroke-box for SVG elements without CSS boxes
features.showcase_hint: content-box and fill-box copies rotate identically, proving the CSS-box keywords alias the SVG boxes.

features.name: Element.setPointerCapture / releasePointerCapture / gotpointercapture
features.showcase_hint: Dragged knob keeps following the pointer even when it leaves the SVG bounds, and releases cleanly on pointerup.

features.name: SVGElement.focus() / blur() / tabIndex
features.showcase_hint: A button calls circle.focus() and a focus ring appears around the circle.

features.name: tabindex on SVG elements (root and shapes focusable)
features.showcase_hint: Pressing Tab moves a visible focus ring from shape to shape; shapes without tabindex are skipped.

features.name: aria-live region announcing SVG state changes
features.support_note: all browsers; announcement requires a screen reader
features.showcase_hint: Hovering data points updates a visually rendered live region text 'Point 3: 42' that assistive tech announces.

features.name: Dragging shapes with pointerdown/move/up and translate updates
features.showcase_hint: Nodes of a diagram can be dragged around; connecting lines follow in real time.

features.name: Invisible wide stroke enlarging hit area of thin lines
features.showcase_hint: 1px line highlights when the pointer is within 12px; the transparent 24px stroke is drawn as a faint guide.

features.name: fill=transparent vs fill=none hit-testing difference
features.showcase_hint: Two outlined squares: the fill=transparent one highlights on its interior, the fill=none one only on the border.

features.name: keydown/keyup on focused SVG elements (arrow-key movement, Enter/Space activation)
features.showcase_hint: Tab to a focusable shape, press arrow keys and it moves; Enter toggles its colour.

features.name: Mouse events on SVG elements (click, dblclick, mousedown/up/move, mouseover/out)
features.showcase_hint: Click cycles a shape's fill; an event log lists event type and target id as the pointer moves over shapes.

features.name: Pointer events (pointerdown/move/up, pointerType, pressure)
features.showcase_hint: Drawing pad: strokes appear under the pointer, width varying with pressure and colour by pointerType (mouse/pen/touch).

features.name: role=button + tabindex + Enter/Space handling on shapes (aria-pressed)
features.showcase_hint: Toggle switch drawn in SVG flips with the Space key, aria-pressed updates, focus ring visible.

features.name: role=group / list / listitem on <g> structuring screen-reader navigation
features.showcase_hint: Legend rendered as role=list with listitem groups; accessibility tree shows a 3-item list.

features.name: Reading order follows DOM order, not visual position (aria-owns / reordering)
features.showcase_hint: Two visually identical charts; one has DOM order matching visual order and reads 1-2-3, the other reads 3-1-2.

features.name: Touch events (touchstart/move/end, TouchList)
features.support_note: all touch devices; absent on desktop Safari and Firefox without touch screens
features.showcase_hint: Each finger on the SVG spawns a numbered circle that follows it; circles vanish on touchend.

features.name: Event retargeting: events inside <use> instances report the <use> as target
features.support_note: all browsers; the shadow tree is closed, composedPath stops at the <use>
features.showcase_hint: Clicking parts of a <use> instance always logs the <use> id, never the inner shape id.

features.name: wheel event driven zoom/pan of the viewBox
features.support_note: all browsers; listener must be non-passive to preventDefault
features.showcase_hint: Scrolling the wheel over the map zooms toward the cursor; the page does not scroll.

features.name: Checkbox/radio hack: input:checked ~ svg or :has(:checked) toggling SVG state
features.showcase_hint: HTML checkbox toggles layer visibility inside an inline SVG purely with CSS; no JavaScript.

features.name: :focus pseudo-class on SVG elements
features.showcase_hint: Focused shape gains a thick highlighted stroke regardless of how focus arrived.

features.name: :focus-visible (keyboard-only focus ring)
features.showcase_hint: Ring appears when reaching a shape via Tab but not when clicking it with the mouse.

features.name: :has() relational selector for state propagation
features.showcase_hint: Chart legend row highlights when the parent svg:has(circle:hover) matches a hovered data point elsewhere.

features.name: :hover on SVG elements and groups
features.showcase_hint: Pie slice enlarges and brightens while the pointer is over it; a sibling label appears via g:hover text rule.

features.name: :target pseudo-class driven by URL fragment
features.showcase_hint: Clicking in-document links to #panel-a/#panel-b reveals the matching panel via :target with no script.

features.name: user-select and native text selection of SVG <text>
features.showcase_hint: Dragging across labels selects text in one column while a user-select:none column cannot be highlighted.

features.name: pointer-events property
features.showcase_hint: Row of identical shapes; hovering each recolours only where its pointer-events value allows hits, a caption naming the value under each.

features.name: touch-action on the <svg> viewport
features.support_note: all browsers on the outermost <svg>; ignored on inner shapes per CSS spec
features.showcase_hint: Dragging inside the SVG on a phone pans the drawing instead of scrolling the page.

features.name: pointer-events: bounding-box
features.support_note: Chrome, Edge and Firefox; Safari unsupported
features.showcase_hint: Star shape highlights when hovering the empty corners of its bounding rectangle, drawn as a dashed guide.

features.name: pointer-events: none (pass-through, inherited)
features.showcase_hint: Label overlay on top of a button never blocks clicks; the button beneath highlights when clicking through the label text.

features.name: document.elementFromPoint / elementsFromPoint on SVG content
features.showcase_hint: Label lists every stacked shape under the cursor from topmost down.

features.name: MouseEvent.offsetX/offsetY on SVG targets
features.support_note: Chrome/Firefox measure from the nearest <svg>; Safari from the target shape
features.showcase_hint: Two readouts per event: offsetX and CTM-converted x; they diverge for shapes inside transformed groups.

features.name: PointerEvent.getCoalescedEvents / getPredictedEvents
features.showcase_hint: Fast pen stroke drawn from coalesced points is smooth while the per-frame-only sibling polyline shows jagged gaps.

features.name: a hreflang / type link metadata
features.support_note: all browsers parse them; no rendering effect
features.showcase_hint: No visible effect; DOM inspector shows the attributes reflected on the SVGAElement.

features.name: a ping
features.support_note: Chrome and Safari send pings; Firefox disabled by default
features.showcase_hint: Network panel shows a POST ping request fired when the SVG link is clicked.

features.name: a referrerpolicy
features.support_note: Chrome and Firefox; Safari ignores on SVG links
features.showcase_hint: Target page echoes the Referer header: empty for referrerpolicy=no-referrer, full URL for the sibling link.

features.name: a xlink:href (legacy)
features.support_note: Still honoured by all browsers but deprecated in SVG 2
features.showcase_hint: Legacy xlink:href link still navigates, shown side by side with plain href for parity.

features.name: autofocus on SVG elements
features.showcase_hint: On load a focus ring already sits on the SVG element marked autofocus with no user interaction.

features.name: onload on <svg> root (SVGLoad renamed to load)
features.support_note: all browsers; on inline SVG the root handler maps to window load
features.showcase_hint: A status text switches from 'loading' to 'ready' via the onload handler when the SVG finishes parsing.

features.name: clip-path removes clipped regions from hit testing; mask and opacity do not
features.showcase_hint: Clipped-away corner of a square ignores hover while the masked-invisible corner of a sibling still highlights.

features.name: contextmenu event (right-click) on SVG elements
features.showcase_hint: Right-clicking a shape opens a custom SVG popup menu instead of the browser menu.

features.name: Script-positioned SVG tooltip following the pointer
features.showcase_hint: A styled rounded box with the data value follows the cursor across chart points and hides on leave.

features.name: Interactivity depends on embedding: /CSS background inert,
features.showcase_hint: Same SVG shown three ways: hover recolours in inline and

features.name: Event bubbling and delegation on a parent <g> via event.target
features.showcase_hint: One listener on a <g> of 50 bars; clicking any bar highlights it and shows its data-* value.

features.name: focus/blur/focusin/focusout on SVG elements (replacing DOMFocusIn/Out)
features.showcase_hint: Tabbing through shapes prints focusin/focusout entries and highlights the shape currently focused.

features.name: In-document links to #id, <view> and svgView(viewBox()) fragments
features.support_note: #id and <view> targets broad; svgView() fragment syntax ignored by Safari
features.showcase_hint: Clicking 'Zoom to region' links changes the visible viewBox of a standalone SVG without script.

features.name: display:none removes from hit-testing; visibility:hidden depends on pointer-events value
features.showcase_hint: Three invisible squares: display none never reacts, visibility hidden reacts only with pointer-events all; label reports which.

features.name: Transparent overlay rect capturing all events for a plot area
features.showcase_hint: Crosshair follows the pointer across gaps between bars because an invisible rect covers the plot area.

features.name: CSS transitions on presentation properties for hover/focus states
features.showcase_hint: Bar fill, stroke-width and transform ease over 300ms when hovered instead of snapping.

features.name: Keyboard-operable HTML controls inside <foreignObject>
features.support_note: Works everywhere; Safari mis-hit-tests foreignObject under transforms
features.showcase_hint: A real HTML range slider inside the SVG drives a bar's height; Tab reaches it like any form control.

features.name: HTML draggable / dragstart on SVG elements
features.support_note: Firefox fires dragstart for SVG shapes; Chrome and Safari do not; drop targets work everywhere
features.showcase_hint: Dragging a circle with draggable=true produces a ghost image only in Firefox; the drop zone accepts HTML items everywhere.

features.name: Inline on* event attributes (onclick, onmouseover, onkeydown)
features.support_note: all browsers; blocked by CSP without unsafe-inline
features.showcase_hint: Shape with onclick="this.setAttribute('fill','red')" turns red on click without external script.

features.name: Marker, pattern and gradient content never receive events
features.showcase_hint: Clicking an arrowhead marker logs the path id, not the marker's inner polygon.

features.name: mouseenter/mouseleave vs bubbling mouseover/mouseout on nested groups
features.showcase_hint: Group with child shapes; counters show mouseover firing per child while mouseenter increments once per group entry.

features.name: Multi-touch pinch-zoom / rotate with pointer or touch events
features.support_note: all browsers; needs touch-action none on the <svg>
features.showcase_hint: Two-finger pinch scales and rotates a picture inside the SVG viewport while the page itself stays still.

features.name: Content outside a nested <svg> viewport is not hittable
features.showcase_hint: Circle spilling past a nested svg's edge only reacts inside the visible viewport; an overflow=visible sibling reacts everywhere.

features.name: WAI-ARIA Graphics roles (graphics-document, graphics-object, graphics-symbol)
features.support_note: Chrome, Firefox and Safari parse them; screen-reader exposure inconsistent
features.showcase_hint: Diagram root exposed as graphics-document with nested graphics-object nodes in the accessibility inspector.

features.name: role=slider / progressbar with aria-valuenow on SVG controls
features.showcase_hint: Arrow keys move a knob along a track; aria-valuenow text and knob position update together.

features.name: SVG 1.1 events (SVGZoom, SVGScroll, SVGResize, DOMActivate, DOMFocusIn, mutation events, onzoom)
features.support_note: Dropped in SVG 2; browsers only fire plain load/resize/scroll/focusin; mutation events removed from Chrome 127
features.showcase_hint: Exclusion: onzoom/onactivate/DOMActivate handlers never fire; counters stay at zero while the plain click counter increments.

features.name: Focus order control (tabindex=0 DOM order, positive values, -1 script-only)
features.showcase_hint: Numbered shapes receive focus in 1-2-3 order despite different DOM order; tabindex=-1 shape only focuses on click.

features.name: Text hit-testing by glyph cells, not bounding box or painted pixels
features.support_note: all browsers; Safari uses tighter glyph geometry
features.showcase_hint: Hovering the gap inside the letter O still highlights the text; hovering outside the line box does not.

features.name: <a> inside <text> wrapping tspans
features.showcase_hint: Only the linked words in a sentence are underlined, blue and clickable; surrounding text is inert.

features.name: :active pressed state
features.showcase_hint: Button rect darkens and shifts down while the mouse button is held, returning on release.

features.name: :focus-within on ancestor <g>
features.showcase_hint: Whole group background lights up while any child shape inside it holds focus.

features.name: :hover / :active styling of <use> instances and cloned children
features.showcase_hint: Several <use> clones of one symbol; only the hovered clone recolours, styled via use:hover rules inheriting into the shadow tree.

features.name: :link / :any-link / :visited on SVG <a>
features.support_note: link/any-link everywhere; :visited only alters colour-like properties and Safari is inconsistent
features.showcase_hint: Unvisited links draw blue, visited ones purple after navigation and back.

features.name: @media (hover) / (pointer: coarse) adaptive hit targets
features.showcase_hint: On touch devices the invisible hit strokes grow wider and hover-only tooltips are replaced by tap labels.

features.name: outline / outline-offset on SVG shapes for focus rings
features.support_note: all browsers; outline follows bounding box, not shape geometry
features.showcase_hint: Focused circle shows a rectangular dashed outline around its bounding box, offset by a few pixels.

features.name: ::selection styling of SVG text
features.support_note: Chrome and Firefox; Safari ignores ::selection on SVG text
features.showcase_hint: Selected SVG words show a custom yellow highlight instead of the default blue.

features.name: System colour keywords (CanvasText, Highlight, LinkText) as fill/stroke
features.showcase_hint: Shapes painted with Highlight and CanvasText match the OS selection and text colours.

features.name: -webkit-tap-highlight-color on tappable SVG links
features.support_note: Chrome Android and Safari iOS; Firefox ignores
features.showcase_hint: Tapping an SVG link on a phone shows no grey flash on the transparent-highlight copy but does on the default copy.

features.name: <handler> element (SVG Tiny 1.2)
features.support_note: SVG Tiny 1.2 only; no current browser
features.showcase_hint: Exclusion: declarative <handler> script never runs; the shape stays unchanged on click.

features.name: <listener> element (SVG Tiny 1.2)
features.support_note: SVG Tiny 1.2 only; no current browser
features.showcase_hint: Exclusion: <listener> routing a click to a handler has no effect; a plain addEventListener sibling reacts.

features.name: pointer-events: all
features.showcase_hint: Fully invisible shape (no fill, no stroke, visibility hidden) still lights a status label on hover anywhere in its geometry.

features.name: pointer-events: auto (CSS alias of visiblePainted on SVG)
features.showcase_hint: Shape styled pointer-events:auto behaves identically to the visiblePainted sibling beside it; caption notes the alias.

features.name: pointer-events: fill
features.showcase_hint: Hidden or fill=none shape reacts across its interior only; a dashed outline marks the invisible target.

features.name: pointer-events: painted
features.showcase_hint: visibility=hidden shape is invisible yet still fires hover (caption updates) because painted ignores visibility.

features.name: pointer-events: stroke
features.showcase_hint: Invisible thick stroke around a thin line widens its hit area; cursor feedback appears well outside the visible line.

features.name: pointer-events: visible
features.showcase_hint: Unpainted shape (fill none, stroke none) shown by a dashed guide still highlights on both interior and stroke geometry.

features.name: pointer-events: visibleFill
features.showcase_hint: fill=none shape highlights when the pointer enters its interior; hovering the painted stroke does nothing.

features.name: pointer-events: visiblePainted (default)
features.showcase_hint: Filled+stroked circle reacts on interior and stroke; a fill=none circle only reacts on its stroke ring, hollow centre passes through.

features.name: pointer-events: visibleStroke
features.showcase_hint: Filled shape highlights only on its outline band; interior is pass-through even though painted.

features.name: touch-action: none / manipulation / pan-x / pinch-zoom values
features.showcase_hint: Side-by-side canvases: touch-action none lets pinch rotate the drawing; the pan-y sibling scrolls the page vertically.
